title: Shopify Operations Specialist (Subscriptions, Online Courses, AI-Assisted) - Part Time, Remote
description:
We are an established online education company teaching wellness and movement courses to students worldwide. We sell courses, teacher trainings, retreats and memberships through Shopify. We run a lean team and use AI tools every day. We need one reliable part-time operations specialist who already works that way, to handle subscription and payment operations, keep student access correct, and back up our support team.





What you will do

Fix subscription exceptions in Appstle: billing dates, free-trial settings, plan swaps, quantities, duplicate subscriptions

Set up and test installment payment plans for trainings and retreats (totals, frequency, number of payments)

Run the weekly failed-payment recovery list and keep our weekly subscription tracking sheet current

Create, test and end discount codes and promo pricing for launches and webinars, with a test checkout as proof

Process refunds and prepare chargeback responses after the owner approves them in the task

Fix student course-access problems in our course platform (Tevello) using customer tags, and check access before live events

Make routine Shopify updates: products, menus, testimonials, page content, simple Shopify Flow alerts

Back up our team: issue certificates and welcome
s for graduating teachers, handle licensee admin (agreements, access and affiliate links), and cover support tickets when our support lead is away

Approve affiliates and group membership requests in a few admin screens

Use AI tools to draft SOPs, replies and checklists and to work through spreadsheets, then check every output before it goes live

Work from ClickUp tasks and attach proof (a screenshot or link) when each task is done

Write short SOPs for the processes you run





Must have

2+ years as a Shopify admin for a live store

Hands-on experience with a subscription app (Appstle, Recharge, Seal, Loop or similar), including payment plans and discounts

Experience with an online course platform (Tevello, Kajabi, Thinkific, Teachable or similar)

Daily, hands-on use of AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude or similar) for real work, and the judgment to catch their mistakes

Clear written English and careful attention to detail

Reliable internet and backup power

Comfortable with time tracking (Hubstaff) and reviews based on finished work

Two past clients we can contact





Nice to have: Klaviyo, ClickUp, Shopify Flow, Loom, Google Sheets, Zapier





Details

Part time, about 20 hours a week, with daily overlap with GMT+7 business hours

A paid 3-hour test task, then a paid 30-day trial

Long-term role and potential full-time for the right person





To apply

Start your application with the name of the subscription app you have used most. Then answer:

What is the most complex thing you set up or fixed in that subscription app?

A customer was charged twice for a course. Walk us through how you refund it and confirm they still have course access.

Share a screenshot or Loom of a Shopify or subscription-app task you handled (hide private data).

Describe one real work task where AI saved you time: which tool, what you asked it, and one mistake it made that you caught.

Which hours can you work, and what is your backup if power or internet goes down?

Names and contact details of two past clients.

title: Part-Time B2B SDR | Paid Training | $480/Month Base + Commissions | Leads, CRM & Dialer Provided
description:
Build a real path into B2B sales-with qualified leads, a CRM, proven scripts, structured training, call coaching, and a professional U.S. dialer already provided.



EditValue provides premium wedding-video post-production for wedding photographers and studios. We are hiring a confident English-speaking SDR to introduce our service to U.S. wedding businesses and help them try a complimentary wedding reel.



Why this role is worth your time:

• You do not need to find your own leads

• We provide the CRM, dialer, sales playbook, scripts, training materials, and coaching

• Every call is recorded so you can receive specific feedback and improve

• Our Local Presence system displays a clean local U.S. caller ID matching the prospect’s area code, which can improve answer rates

• There is a clear paid path from training to live calls and long-term work

• Base pay plus uncapped commissions rewards both consistency and results



Schedule:

• Monday-Friday only; no weekend calling

• 9:00 AM-1:00 PM in the local U.S. time zone assigned to your leads

• Four consecutive hours per day

• This normally means evening or overnight hours in the Philippines, depending on the assigned U.S. territory



Your responsibilities:

• Make 200 calls per day during your four-hour calling shift (50 calls per hour), both during the live trial and regular work

• Speak naturally and confidently with wedding photographers and studio owners

• Explain EditValue clearly and offer one complimentary wedding reel

• Ask useful questions, identify decision-makers, and follow up with interested studios

• Accurately record dispositions and notes in the CRM

• The key outcome is getting an interested wedding studio to send footage for its complimentary reel



Compensation after successfully completing the live trial:

• $480/month guaranteed base

• $20 for every qualified wedding studio that submits wedding footage

• Unlimited commissions



Your clear path into the role:

Initial application screening - Submit the short mock-call voice audition below, followed by the unpaid SDR scenario test if invited. This screening is separate from the five paid bootcamp stages.



1. SDR101 - Knowledge ($2): Learn EditValue’s service, the complimentary-reel offer, listening, and objection handling.

2. SDR102 - Voice Readiness ($5): Practice clear, warm, assured delivery and receive coaching through simulated conversations.

3. SDR103 - Call Training ($10): Complete and submit all 25 training calls, applying the feedback after each call.

4. SDR104 - Validation ($5): Complete a fresh assessment to demonstrate what you learned and how your performance improved.

5. SDR105 - One-Day Live Trial ($10): After approval and scheduling, use our dialer, CRM, and leads for a supervised live calling trial.



The five stages offer $32 in total. Stage completion, verification, and qualification are reviewed separately; payment is not automatic. We provide the applicable completion and payment-request instructions at each stage. Advancement requires meeting that stage’s requirements.



Longer-term opportunity - Strong performers may advance to further evaluation and ongoing employment.



Payments during the assessment process are made through PayPal, so you must be able to receive PayPal payments.



Who will do well:

• Excellent spoken English and clear pronunciation

• Confidence speaking with U.S. business owners

• Previous B2B, SDR, appointment-setting, or cold-calling experience is preferred

• Coachable, reliable, and willing to apply feedback quickly

• Comfortable working the stated U.S. hours

• Reliable computer, internet connection, and microphone

• Consistent, accurate CRM use



Learn about the service before applying: 



How to apply:

Send a 15-25 second voice recording.



Imagine Amanda, a wedding photography studio owner, just answered your call.

Deliver this opening like a skilled actor making the conversation feel real - with confidence, warmth, and clarity:



“Hi Amanda, I’m [Your name]. I help wedding studios catch up on editing. Do you need a hand with your highlight films or wedding reels?”



Smile as you speak. Sound assured and conversational, then end the recording.



While you record, make sure to avoid a dry reading, rushed words, a hesitant tone, or speaking too softly.



Perform the opening - not a self-introduction about your background.



Applications without a recording will not be considered.

title: Video Editor — Supplement VSL Talking-Head Ads (English, AI-friendly) — Full-Time, Remote
description:
We're hiring a full-time, remote video editor for direct-response e-commerce (supplements and DR health) VSL-style ads. Long-term role, not a one-off gig.



The format we care about: talking-head ads. A person talking to camera (AI talking-head or real, either is fine) carries the ad, with b-roll clips or on-screen photos layered on top (roughly 15 to 30 percent of the screen time). This is NOT voiceover-over-b-roll, NOT fast-cut montages, and NOT 3D/animation or song ads. The talking head is the spine; the visuals support it.



What matters:

- Clean, engaging, English-language editing with natural pacing.

- You're comfortable generating AI clips and photos yourself. If a visual needs to be generated, you can create it (realistic AI footage, AI scenes, or simple AI product shots like a bottle on a white background all count), not just drop in stock footage. No 3D animation, that does not count here.

- The product is introduced naturally, not jammed into the first 10 seconds.

- Good audio and clean pronunciation on talking heads.



Must have:

- At least 3 talking-head ecommerce ads you personally edited, each around 1.5 minutes or longer, with visuals (clips or photos) layered on top that include AI-generated ones you made.



How to apply (applications without the 3 videos will not be considered):

1. Send direct links to your 3 BEST talking-head video ads (each around 1.5 minutes or longer, with b-roll or photos on top, including AI clips or photos you generated yourself).

2. One line on your process for generating the AI clips, and which moments in those videos are AI.

3. A one-line note on your full-time availability.



Pay: competitive, full-time. We pay well for the right person.

Configure the AI agent with a roofing-specific prompt (handling roof replacement/repair inquiries, emergency leaks, storm damage inspections, and estimate scheduling).



Roofing Appointment Booking & SMS Text-Back Workflow:



Build automated Missed Call Text-Back sequences in GHL tailored for home improvement/roofing leads.



Send instant SMS/Email confirmations, calendar booking links for roof inspections, and automated appointment reminders.



Outbound AI Database Reactivation Campaign (Outbound Roofing Demo):



Configure outbound AI calling workflows to dial older database leads provided with past inquiry dates.



Set up conversational AI flows to reactivate old roofing leads (e.g., "Checking in on your roof estimate from earlier this year"), qualify them, and schedule an inspection directly onto the GHL calendar.



Testing, Tagging & Final Output:



Deliver 2 distinct, fully functional Roofing Demo Request setups ready for live testing by roofer clients.



Ensure clean contact tagging, pipeline stage movements, calendar sync, and error handling (voi
 detection, DNC tags).



Required Skills & Qualifications

Proven GHL Mastery: Deep knowledge of GHL Workflows, Calendars, Pipelines, Custom Fields, and Triggers.



AI Voice Platform Expertise: Hands-on experience integrating GHL with AI calling platforms (Bland AI, Retell AI, Vapi, or native GHL Voice AI).



Niche Context: Experience building automations for local home service contractors (roofing, HVAC, plumbing, etc.) is a huge plus.



Reliable Testing Mindset: Ability to thoroughly test conversational flows to make sure edge cases (voi
s, busy signals, wrong numbers) don't break workflows.



How to Apply

When applying on OnlineJobs.ph, please send:



Relevant Portfolio/Examples: Brief  GHL AI voice missed-call automation demo you have built for local service contractors.



AI Voice Platform: Mention which AI voice tool (Retell, Bland, Vapi, etc.) you prefer or have used with GHL.



Availability Confirmation: Confirm you can commit to a 40-hour allocation within a 7-day turnaround time to build the 2 required roofing demo setups.



Your Favorite Trigger: To confirm you read this entire post, start your response with the word "AUTOMATE".



Candidates select who perform well, will be considered for full time opportunity

title: Short-Form UGC Video Editor (TikTok, Reels & Meta Ads)
description:
**Hiring: Short-Form UGC Video Editor**



I'm a full-time UGC content creator working with brands to produce short-form videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and Meta advertising.



I'm looking for a reliable, creative video editor who can help me produce high-quality videos consistently.



**What You'll Be Doing**



- Editing short-form UGC videos, typically 15–60 seconds

- Adding captions, B-roll, key framing, overlays, and sound effects when appropriate

- Creating multiple video variations using different hooks, bodies, and CTAs

- Following my existing editing style while bringing your own creative ideas

- Organizing finished videos and project files in Google Drive

- Delivering edits consistently and making revisions when needed



**Workload & Compensation**



- Starting pay: $100 USD per week

- Target output: Up to 50 short-form video exports per week, including variations

- Flexible working hours

- Opportunity for a long-term working relationship

- Compensation and workload may be adjusted as the business grows



**What I'm Looking For**



- Experience editing TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, or UGC ads

- Strong understanding of hooks, pacing, captions, and viewer retention

- Experience with CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, or similar editing software

- Good English comprehension

- Strong attention to detail

- Ability to work independently and meet deadlines



**HOW TO APPLY**



I care more about your editing ability than your resume.



To be considered, you'll need to complete two short editing assessments.



**TEST 1: Recreate My Video**



I'll provide a Google Drive folder containing a finished video and its raw footage.



Your task is to recreate the finished video as closely as possible, including cuts, captions, pacing, and overlays.



**TEST 2: Create Your Own Edit**



I'll provide separate raw footage, B-roll, and other assets.



I want to see how you think creatively, not just how well you can copy.



**SUBMISSION**



Send your portfolio, the editing software you use, and a brief introduction explaining your short-form editing experience.



Shortlisted applicants will receive the editing assessment instructions.



I'm looking for someone who wants to grow with me long-term, not just complete a one-time project.

title: AU Senior Tax Accountant
description:
ROLE SUMMARY



Senior-level Australian public-practice role responsible for tax compliance, tax planning, financial analysis, and business advisory for SMEs.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



- Prepare and review financial statements and income tax returns for companies, trusts, partnerships, sole traders, and individuals.

- Prepare and review BAS and IAS, including GST and PAYG reconciliations.

- Review shareholder and related-party loan accounts and assess Division 7A, including complying loan arrangements, benchmark interest, minimum yearly repayments, distributable surplus, and deemed-dividend exposure.

- Prepare and review CGT calculations, including CGT events, capital proceeds, cost base, capital losses, discounts, concessions, and rollovers.

- Prepare and review FBT calculations and returns, including motor vehicles, entertainment, employee contributions, exemptions, reductions, and taxable values.

- Review trust taxable income, beneficiary entitlements, distribution resolutions, franking implications, and Division 7A considerations involving corporate beneficiaries.

- Prepare book-to-tax adjustments, tax reconciliations, franking-account reconciliations, and supporting tax workpapers.

- Perform quarterly tax planning using year-to-date results and projected full-year profitability.

- Calculate projected income-tax liabilities and assess PAYG instalments and upcoming tax cash requirements.

- Prepare budgets, forecasts, and cash-flow analysis for business advisory engagements.

- Analyse profitability, working capital, cash-flow constraints, financial trends, and business performance.

- Assist with business structuring, tax planning, technical taxation research, and written client advice.

- Handle technical client queries and ATO correspondence within delegated authority.

- Review accounting and taxation work prepared by other team members.

- Communicate directly with clients to request information, explain tax positions, discuss financial results, and provide practical commercial advice.

- Maintain high-quality workpapers, supporting documentation, client files, and compliance workflows.



REQUIREMENTS



- CPA qualification is a BIG PLUS.

- Minimum 5 years of Australian public-practice accounting and taxation experience.

- Strong Australian taxation knowledge across companies, trusts, partnerships, sole traders, and individuals.

- Strong technical knowledge of Division 7A, CGT, FBT, GST, BAS, IAS, PAYG, trust distributions, and tax planning.

- Strong financial-statement preparation and tax-return preparation/review experience.

- Strong commercial judgment and ability to connect tax outcomes with the client’s cash flow, profitability, strategy, and business objectives.

- Strong written and spoken English with confidence communicating directly with Australian clients.



TOOLS



Xero | Xero Tax | Xero Practice Manager (XPM)



EMPLOYEE BENEFITS



- Independent Contractor (no payroll deductions)

- 100% reimbursed government contributions (SSS, PhilHealth, and Pag-IBIG) — you pay your contributions directly, and you will be reimbursed the full amount, so there is no deduction from your salary

- 13th-month pay

- HMO coverage

- Paid leaves and paid holidays

- Fully remote setup



HOW TO APPLY



Send a short cover letter highlighting your relevant experience.

IMPORTANT: Include a Google Drive link to your résumé and ensure the file is set to “Anyone with the link can view.”

title: Electrical Engineer / Quantity Surveyor - Remote
description:
Please follow the application instructions below.



PropFix.ie is Ireland's trusted property maintenance specialist, offering comprehensive solutions with years of expertise across the construction and renovation sectors. We transform spaces through our diverse range of services, from handyman solutions and office fit-outs to complete renovations, house extensions, and specialized installations including doors, floors, and partitions.



Our commitment to delivering high-quality property maintenance and electrical solutions has made us a trusted partner for residential, commercial, and industrial clients nationwide. With decades of experience in electrical systems, installations, and maintenance, we take pride in our technical expertise and craftsmanship—ensuring our clients’ properties remain safe, efficient, and fully compliant with modern standards.



Role Overview



We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Electrical Engineer to join our team. This role involves electrical design, project coordination, system analysis, and technical documentation. The successful candidate will work closely with project managers, site teams, and clients to ensure accurate planning, safe installations, and seamless execution of all electrical works—from concept design to project completion.



Key Responsibilities

Electrical Engineering & Design



Electrical System Design: Develop, review, and interpret electrical plans, schematics, and load calculations.

Technical Specifications: Prepare detailed specifications, diagrams, SLDs (single-line diagrams), and layout drawings.

Material & Equipment Selection: Determine appropriate electrical components, materials, and equipment required for projects.

Compliance & Standards: Ensure designs meet electrical codes, safety standards, and regulatory requirements.



Project Coordination & Client Management



Site Coordination: Work with contractors, site engineers, and electricians to ensure proper installation and site execution.

Client Communication: Liaise with clients to clarify requirements, provide technical updates, and explain engineering decisions.

Documentation: Prepare project reports, progress updates, testing results, QA/QC records, and risk assessments.

Change Management: Document revisions to electrical plans and update load calculations, cost impacts, and schedules accordingly.



Testing, Maintenance & Quality Control



System Testing: Perform testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting of electrical systems and equipment.

Preventive Maintenance: Evaluate system performance and recommend maintenance schedules or upgrades.

Safety Compliance: Ensure all electrical work follows safety protocols, lock-out/tag-out procedures, and hazard assessments.



Financial Administration & Office Support



Cost Estimation: Prepare electrical cost estimates, material take-offs, and assist in budget planning.

Invoice & Documentation: Support invoicing, procurement coordination, and inventory updates for electrical materials.

Technical Records: Maintain accurate documentation, permits, and electrical certification records.



Required Skills & Experience

Technical Requirements



Electrical Engineering: Proven experience in electrical design, installation supervision, testing, and commissioning.

Codes & Standards: Strong understanding of local electrical codes, NEC/IEC standards, and safety regulations.

Technical Proficiency: Skilled in electrical drafting tools (AutoCAD, Revit MEP, or similar) and testing instruments.

Project Knowledge: Familiarity with construction processes, electrical layouts, and engineering documentation, and project management using Tradify.



Professional Skills



Analytical Ability: Strong problem-solving and technical analysis skills.

Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication for client and contractor coordination.

Organization: Ability to handle multiple projects, documentation, and scheduling tasks efficiently.

Adaptability: Capable of managing both office-based work and technical project duties.



What We Offer



Competitive compensation package

Opportunities to work with clients across Ireland and the UK

Professional development and training programs

Collaborative and supportive remote work environment

Clear career advancement pathways

Exposure to diverse engineering and construction projects

Flexible remote working systems with comprehensive support



Application Reminders

Submit your updated CV and portfolio (if applicable). Please ensure both documents are current and highlight your most relevant skills and work experience.



Include any international or remote work experience in your employment history, if applicable. If you do not have foreign or remote work experience, that's completely fine—we still encourage you to apply.



List all software, tools, and platforms you are proficient in. Be sure to include all relevant applications and technologies you have experience using so we can better assess your qualifications against the role requirements.



Application instructions

Thank you, and we look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Digital Marketing Strategist & Operations Lead
description:
We’re looking for an experienced marketer who can get to know a business, identify where its marketing can improve, and put together a practical plan to move it forward.



You’ll be a part of doing this for our Agency and our clients. That means researching companies and their customers, developing strategies, and turning those strategies into website improvements, content, campaigns, and clear next steps for our team.



We need someone who can make thoughtful recommendations, explain them to a client, and follow through. You should be comfortable doing hands-on work, coordinating with specialists, and checking that the finished result does what we intended.



AI should already be part of how you work. We want someone who is actively finding useful ways to save time, improve quality, and make recurring work easier for the whole team.



Research / Planning



- Learn how a business makes money, who its customers are, what those customers need, and how it compares with competitors.

- Review its website, industry and marketing to identify opportunities and problems worth addressing.

- Develop a strategy with clear priorities, supported by research and available data.

- Break that strategy into specific tasks, with realistic deadlines, responsibilities, and measures of success.

- Recommend where to focus our effort and what can wait.



Websites, Content, and Campaigns



- Recommend improvements to website messaging, navigation, service pages, landing pages, forms, and calls to action.

- Plan and help produce content, case studies,
s, newsletters, and supporting social content.

- Give writers, designers, and developers clear direction and enough context to do their work well.

- Write or revise copy when needed.

- Review finished work, coordinate approvals, and check that everything works correctly once it goes live.



HubSpot & Marketing Operations



- Work with HubSpot contacts, lists, forms,
s, workflows, lead routing, and reports.

- Help ensure inquiries reach the right person and receive appropriate follow-up.

- Coordinate technical support when needed and test the completed work.

- Keep useful documentation so someone else can understand and maintain what you’ve built.



Reporting & Interfacing



- Prepare and oversee regular marketing reports, checking contributions from other team members.

- Explain what changed, what the results mean, and what you recommend doing next.

- Connect reporting to meaningful business goals, including qualified inquiries and opportunities.

- Participate confidently in client meetings, ask good questions, and explain recommendations in plain English.

- Record decisions and follow up on commitments, approvals, and outstanding questions.



AI and Integrations



- Use AI regularly for research, planning, drafting, analysis, reporting, and other appropriate tasks.

- Develop reusable workflows and templates that make recurring work faster and more consistent.

- Check facts, calculations, and recommendations before using or sharing AI-generated work.

- Recognize when an output needs more research, correction, or human judgment.

- Share useful approaches with the team and help others adopt them.

- Handle company and client information responsibly.



Keeps Progressing



- Manage your priorities and deadlines without repeated reminders.

- Keep the team informed about progress, missing information, and decisions needed.

- Raise problems early, with a suggested way forward.

- Coordinate work with colleagues and outside specialists.

- Make handoffs clear: what is finished, what remains, who owns the next step, and when it is due.



**What we’re looking for**



- Five or more years of relevant digital marketing experience, with examples of work you’ve owned from planning through delivery.

- Experience researching a business and turning what you learn into a useful marketing strategy.

- Strong understanding of website content, SEO, conversion improvement,
 marketing, and performance measurement.

- Practical HubSpot experience, including workflows, segmentation, forms, campaigns, and reporting.

- Familiarity with WordPress, HubSpot Content Hub, GA4, GSC, GTM, Semrush, SE Rankings and Ahrefs.

- Excellent written and spoken English, with the confidence to discuss strategy and results with US-based clients.

- Experience managing several accounts or projects at once. Agency experience is a plus.

- Established AI workflows you can demonstrate and explain.

- Good judgment, attention to detail, and a dependable approach to remote work.



We care about what you can demonstrate: the decisions you made, the work you delivered, and what you learned from the results.



Schedule and Working Arrangements



This is a remote position based in the Philippines. You’ll need consistent availability during our US Eastern business hours for team collaboration, client meetings, and timely communication.



We’ll agree on the exact schedule before hiring. It will include evening or overnight hours in the Philippines. You’ll also need reliable internet, a suitable space for video calls, and backup arrangements for power or connectivity interruptions.



**What doing this job well looks like**



You bring us clear recommendations and turn them into completed work. Coworkers are accessible to to for co-working, consult and guidance. Clients understand what we’re doing and why. Reports help us d
 what to do next. Deadlines are managed, problems are raised early, and the team can rely on your follow-through.



Over time, the processes and AI workflows you build should help us deliver better work with less repetition and rework.



Interested?



Send your résumé, expected monthly compensation in Philippine pesos, and availability during US Eastern business hours. Please also include:



- An example of a business you researched, the strategy you recommended, and the website or campaign work that followed.

- A report or presentation you prepared, with a brief explanation of your contribution.

- Two examples of how you currently use AI at work, how you check the output, and what the process has improved.



Please remove confidential information from any samples. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to walk us through their work and complete a short, paid practical exercise. Recruiters, auto-submitted applicants and complete ai-generated responses will be deleted.If you want a real career with good pay and opportunity then show that.

We are a rapidly growing e-commerce company operating multiple brands across platforms including Meta Ads, Google Ads, Instagram, TikTok and more.

You will be responsible for combining **AI video generation, UGC-style creative and professional video editing** to produce advertisements that feel native to platforms such as Instagram,
 and TikTok.



The goal is simple:



**Create AI-generated videos that feel like genuine content filmed by a real person on their phone.**



You should understand how to avoid the overly polished, unnatural or artificial look commonly associated with AI-generated content.



Working from scripts, briefs, references and existing creative concepts, you will generate and edit content with a strong focus on:



- Realistic AI-generated people, environments and product interactions

- Native Instagram and TikTok pacing

- Direct-response storytelling

You will also be expected to understand current trends across **Instagram Reels, TikTok and Meta advertising**, including the visual styles and editing techniques that make content feel organic to these platforms.

- At least 1 year of professional video editing experience, preferably within e-commerce or social media advertising

, Instagram and TikTok

title: BIM Production Modeler
description:

What You’ll Do

Create and modify structural and civil elements based on provided drawings and specifications.



Produce project deliverables in formats such as RVT and IFC.



Follow defined modeling standards, naming conventions, and project instructions.



Record modeling actions, assumptions, and revisions when required.



Perform basic QA/QC checks before submitting completed work.



Address reviewer feedback and revise models as needed.



Escalate unclear or conflicting information instead of making unsupported assumptions.



Initial projects will primarily focus on civil and structural modeling. Opportunities to work on MEP and other disciplines may be available as the scope expands.

Graduate or undergraduate degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Construction Engineering, or a related field - undergraduate students are welcome to submit their applications.

Basic understanding of AutoCAD and/or Revit is preferred.



BIM experience is an advantage but is not required.

Strong attention to detail and ability to follow standardized processes.

Reliable internet connection and computer capable of running BIM software.



Ideal Candidate

Remote

Ongoing project-based work available for strong performers

Attention to detail



Ability to follow instructions



Documentation and QA/QC habits

BIM/CAD software you have used



Years of experience, if any

title: CRO Consultant
description:
We're seeking a Conversion Strategist to fulfil a vital role in the delivery of CRO projects, from identifying optimisation opportunities using analysis and research to implementing and measuring split test experiments.



This job role is an excellent opportunity to join an tech startup and digital agency.



The successful candidate will sit within the CRO team and report to the Management Team. They will work closely with the wider team to define and deliver impactful strategies and testing programmes for our clients.



 This role requires an individual who is a team player, well organised, with high attention to detail, who is prepared to build trust through hard work, effective communication and a desire to learn. 



You'll need to have a passion for delivering exceptional experiences to users, but you'll also appreciate the value of using data and real user feedback to support your ideas. You'll need to be prepared to experiment and learn. You don't see blockers where others might; you see opportunities to innovate around them.



What you'll be doing…

You'll work with our clients and be supported by a fantastic team and work together to analyse, understand and solve conversion problems and realise objectives.



You'll identify and conceptualise solutions to conversion problems, split test them and report on how awesome your ideas proved to be. For this, you will need to:



Analyse, hypothesize and prioritise



Interrogate data and user behaviour to build a true picture of performance across any given user journey

Uncover the 'why' behind an issue by evaluating user experiences and by gathering real user feedback from user testing (delivered by working with our user research team)

Pool results from analysis and research to construct informed and high-quality hypotheses that recommend solutions to remove blockers and/or enhance persuasive signals

Prioritise hypotheses by assessing and scoring them objectively against various criteria

Implement experiments



Work with designers, developers and project managers to implement experiments efficiently and effectively – creating design briefs, attending ideation workshops, creating simple mock-ups and writing test requirement briefs that communicate all aspects of a test

Set up robust split tests using a testing platform, carry out quality assurance testing and launch safely

Learn from results, report and refine



Monitor the progress of tests, interpret results using sound statistical analysis and draw additional critical insight by deep-diving segment data

Report to clients and internal stakeholders on the progress and results of experiments, providing clients with accurate and understandable recommendations and reports

Refine and develop optimisation strategies in line with client goals and changes in their environment

Maintain and develop client relationships to meet/exceed KPI targets

What you'll bring



Essential experience and skillset



Experience working in an online or digital role (agency or client-side)

Experience with web analytics tools and able to draw insights from data

Data analysis and manipulation skills, e.g. using MS Excel, Google Sheets etc.

An understanding of the core principles of CRO and UX and how they can be applied to web properties to improve performance

Strong verbal and written communication skills

Excellent time management and organisation

Self-motivated to deliver high-quality work in a fast-paced environment

High attention to detail

Analytical yet creative

Passionate about the industry, willing to learn and actively keeps their knowledge up-to-date



Desirable



Working knowledge of Google Analytics

Experience in evaluating user experiences or involvement in user testing projects

Knowledge or experience in using a testing platform to run split tests

Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript and jQuery would be beneficial but not essential

Comfortable communicating complex technical solutions to a mixed audience with varying levels of understanding

Experience in creating innovative and elegant web solutions to resolve conversion or usability issues

Experience and involvement in website development projects

Experience using statistical methods to interpret conversion test results

Experience in working with businesses of various sizes, including national or international

description:
KING OF THE PITCH — TWO-EVENT VIDEO CLEANUP PROJECT



We need an editor for a straightforward, one-time project: sync and clean up footage from two separate football events, then deliver one continuous landscape video for each event. The focus is camera/audio synchronization, basic color correction and clean event assembly. We are looking for an efficient turnaround, confirmed after you review the footage.



BUDGET

Firm maximum: US$300 TOTAL for BOTH events combined, not $300 per event. Quote your fixed total within this cap, including footage review, synchronization, cleanup, exports, editable project handoff and agreed revisions. Review the files and confirm the scope, turnaround and included revision rounds before starting.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

• KOP1: arrange the footage in event/match order, sync the two camera angles where they overlap, and assemble clean continuous coverage. Use the available camera audio; there is no separate main audio track.

• Second event (folder named “KOP3 proxi files”): synchronize separately recorded camera angles and audio, check sync throughout, and assemble continuous coverage using suitable angles.

• Correct exposure, white balance and color differences between cameras. Clean and balance the original audio.

• Trim obvious downtime such as camera adjustments and long inactive stretches, while preserving complete plays and useful reactions.

• Deliver one finished landscape master per event plus organized editable Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve projects with synchronized camera/audio tracks preserved for a later clip editor. Flag missing media or full-resolution originals needed for final export before agreeing the job.



This assignment does not include social clips, highlight reels, captions, promotional graphics, added music or elaborate effects. Another editor will handle short-form content afterward. The final lengths should follow the usable event coverage, not an arbitrary highlights runtime.



WHO SHOULD APPLY

Editors with hands-on multicamera synchronization and event cleanup experience. Wedding, concert, live-event and sports editors are welcome. Football experience is helpful but not required. You must have a computer, storage and internet connection capable of handling large video files.



TO APPLY

1. Share one relevant event/multicamera sample and explain what you personally synchronized and edited.

2. Tell us your editing software, RAM, available storage and internet speed.

3. Confirm that your fixed total for both events will not exceed $300, and give your estimated turnaround and included revision rounds. We will share the footage for review before final agreement.



No custom unpaid sample is required. Please do not begin editing until the scope, price and delivery timing are agreed.

title: Sales & Business Development Manager
description:
Sales & Business Development Manager — Canada 


Location: Canada / Remote 

Employment Type: Full-time 

Reports to: Leadership Team 

About Velocity 

Velocity helps organizations improve workforce efficiency, visibility, and operational performance 

through technology. 

We are entering an important stage of growth in the Canadian market, and we are looking for a hands

on Sales & Business Development Manager to help us turn that opportunity into real customers. 

This is not a traditional “wait for inbound leads” sales role. Over the next 90 days, you will be responsible 

for actively identifying the right Canadian organizations, building relationships with decision-makers, 

creating qualified opportunities, and moving prospects through the sales process. 

You will have marketing support behind you, including content, campaigns, lead magnets, webinars, paid 

advertising, social media and sales materials. Your job is to turn that activity into conversations, 

opportunities and customers. 

What You'll Own 

1. Canadian Prospecting & Market Development 

Build and actively manage a targeted Canadian prospect database. 

You will: 

• Identify priority industries, organizations and accounts that fit Velocity's ideal customer profile. 

• Build and maintain a targeted list of 100–200+ Canadian accounts. 

• Identify relevant decision-makers, including CEOs, COOs, HR leaders, Operations leaders, Payroll 

leaders and other workforce decision-makers. 

• Research organizations, their current challenges and potential buying signals. 

• Segment prospects by industry, company size, geography and role. 

• Develop account-based prospecting strategies for high-value opportunities. 

2. Outbound Sales & Relationship Building 

Take ownership of turning prospects into conversations. 

You will: 

• Develop and execute targeted outbound campaigns. 

• Conduct personalized
 and LinkedIn outreach. 

• Engage with target decision-makers and relevant industry communities. 

• Build genuine relationships rather than relying exclusively on high-volume outreach. 

• Follow up consistently with prospects and campaign-generated leads. 

• Respond to inbound leads and determine their potential fit. 

• Develop referral and introduction opportunities. 

• Represent Velocity professionally in Canadian business communities and networks. 

3. Lead Qualification & Pipeline Management 

Own the commercial pipeline from first conversation through close. 

You will: 

• Qualify leads and determine whether they fit Velocity's ICP. 

• Score and prioritize opportunities. 

• Move qualified leads from marketing engagement into active sales opportunities. 

• Maintain accurate CRM records and pipeline stages. 

• Establish and maintain follow-up schedules. 

• Track opportunities, next steps, decision-makers and buying timelines. 

• Ensure no qualified lead goes cold. 

• Provide clear weekly pipeline reporting to leadership. 

4. Sales Conversations, Demos & Closing 

Own the sales conversation and drive opportunities toward conversion. 

You will: 

• Conduct discovery calls with prospective customers. 

• Understand the prospect's workforce, operational and administrative challenges. 

• Clearly articulate Velocity's value proposition and business case. 

• Coordinate and/or lead product demonstrations. 

• Work with Operations/Product when deeper product expertise is required. 

• Prepare proposals and commercial follow-ups. 

• Handle objections and move prospects toward a buying decision. 

• Negotiate commercial discussions within approved parameters. 

• Close new customer relationships. 

• Support the transition of new customers into implementation/onboarding. 

5. Partnerships & Business Development 

Identify opportunities to expand Velocity's reach through strategic relationships. 

You will: 

• Identify potential referral, channel and strategic partners. 

• Initiate partnership conversations. 

• Develop mutually beneficial partnership opportunities. 

• Manage partner relationships through negotiation and onboarding. 

• Support referral and co-selling opportunities. 

• Identify organizations and communities that can help Velocity reach Canadian decision-makers. 

6. Market Intelligence 

Bring real-world Canadian market knowledge back into the business. 

You will: 

• Monitor competitor positioning, offers and acquisition strategies. 

• Identify market trends and emerging customer needs. 

• Gather feedback from prospects about their workforce and operational challenges. 

• Identify gaps in the market and opportunities for Velocity. 

• Share customer and prospect insights with Marketing, Operations and Leadership. 

• Help refine our Canadian ICP, messaging and sales approach based on what you are hearing in 

the market. 

What We're Looking For 

We are looking for someone who is: 

• A proven B2B sales and business development professional. 

• Comfortable owning a full sales cycle rather than only lead generation or appointment setting. 

• Experienced selling into organizations and working with senior decision-makers. 

• Strong at consultative selling and discovery. 

• Highly organized and disciplined with CRM and pipeline management. 

• Comfortable with outbound prospecting and relationship-based selling. 

• Confident leading sales conversations and presentations. 

• Commercially minded and comfortable asking for the business. 

• A strong communicator who can build trust quickly. 

• Comfortable working independently in a growing company. 

• Curious about how businesses operate and able to uncover operational pain points. 

• Familiar with the Canadian business market and Canadian workforce environment. 

You may be especially well suited to this role if you have experience selling: 

• Workforce management technology 

• HR technology / HRIS 

• Payroll or payroll-adjacent technology 

• Operations software 

• SaaS 

• Business process or workforce solutions 

• Enterprise or mid-market technology 

• Services involving HR, operations or workforce efficiency 

The Kind of Person Who Will Thrive Here 

We're looking for a builder. 

Someone who doesn't need a perfectly built sales machine handed to them. Someone who can look at a 

market, identify the right people, figure out how to reach them, start conversations, learn from those 

conversations and keep moving opportunities forward. 

You should be comfortable hearing “no,” figuring out why, adjusting your approach and trying again. 

You should also be comfortable working closely with Marketing and Leadership in a fast-moving 

environment where the sales process is still being built. 

Why Join Velocity? 

This is an opportunity to play a foundational role in building Velocity's Canadian market presence. 

You won't simply inherit a territory and a list of accounts. You'll help build the Canadian sales motion 

itself; identifying the market, developing relationships, shaping our approach and turning early 

customers into the foundation for future growth. 

If you are energized by the idea of building something rather than simply maintaining it, we'd love to 

hear from you.

title: Senior Video Editor
description:
SENIOR VIDEO EDITOR — ECOMMERCE META ADS

Remote | Full-time | $900–$1,500 USD depending on experience



ABOUT MHI MEDIA



MHI Media is a performance marketing agency helping ambitious e-commerce and DTC brands grow. We create and test the ads that drive sales for brands operating at serious scale.



Our creative team is made up of editors, designers, strategists and pod leads working together across a large portfolio of brands. We produce a high volume of creative, learn from performance data and improve quickly — so this is a great environment for someone who wants to become genuinely excellent at advertising, not just make videos that look nice.



THE ROLE



We are looking for a high-quality Video Editor who understands that a paid social ad has one job: earn attention, communicate the idea clearly and move the viewer towards action.



You will edit e-commerce video ads for Meta from briefs, scripts, references and raw assets. You will work closely with creative strategists and pod leads, submit work for internal QA, respond to feedback and keep improving your output over time.



This role is not for someone who needs to be chased through every step. We want an editor who can understand a brief, make strong creative decisions, check their own work and deliver reliably.



WHAT YOU’LL DO



- Edit e-commerce video ads for Meta, generally using UGC, product footage, stock, screen recordings, founder content, AI-generated assets and b-roll

- Build strong opening hooks and produce thoughtful variations from winning creative

- Create clear, well-paced edits with effective captions, text overlays, sound design, music and light motion graphics

- Follow the brief and reference closely while adapting the edit to the product, audience and brand

- Make sure visuals, voiceover, captions, claims, offers, product details and brand assets all match the brief

- Submit organised work through our production workflow and meet agreed deadlines

- Apply QA feedback accurately rather than repeating the same mistakes

- Repurpose winning concepts into new hooks, edits, lengths, placements and aspect ratios

- Communicate early when a brief, asset or deadline is unclear or blocked

- Study performance feedback and use it to make future creative stronger



WHAT GREAT PERFORMANCE LOOKS LIKE



- Your first version is already clean, considered and close to the brief

- You understand why a hook, cut, pause, caption or visual is being used — not just how to add it

- You catch spelling, pacing, safe-zone, branding, continuity and audio issues before submitting

- You can take direct feedback without becoming defensive and implement it properly

- You are reliable: deadlines are met, blockers are raised early and tasks do not disappear

- Your work gets better as you learn what performs for different audiences and brands

- Strategists and pod leads trust you with increasingly important work



WHO WE WANT



We want operators, not talkers.



You will probably do well here if you are:



- Performance-minded: interested in what makes people stop, watch and buy

- Detail-obsessed: you notice the one typo, wrong product, weak cut or incorrect logo before anyone else does

- A strong brief reader: you follow direction precisely and ask questions when something is unclear

- Coachable: you actively want detailed feedback and use it to improve

- Proactive: you look for the next useful action instead of waiting to be chased

- Fast but not careless: you can work at volume without lowering your standards

- Commercially curious: you want to understand the customer, offer, audience and creative strategy behind the edit

- A clear communicator: you can explain your decisions and flag problems early

- Comfortable working remotely with a distributed team and shared deadlines



This probably will not be the right role for you if you only want to make cinematic edits, dislike performance-driven work, ignore briefs, take feedback personally or need constant supervision.



REQUIREMENTS



- 2+ years of professional video editing experience

- A portfolio showing e-commerce, direct-response, paid social, UGC or comparable advertising work

- Strong skills in Premiere Pro, CapCut or a similar professional editing tool

- Working knowledge of motion graphics, captions, sound design, music and basic colour correction

- Strong understanding of pacing, hooks, retention and vertical video formats

- Professional written and spoken English

- Reliable computer, internet connection and availability for full-time remote work

- Ability to work within a structured workflow and meet deadlines consistently



NICE TO HAVE



- Experience editing Meta ads for DTC or e-commerce brands

- Experience working from performance data or iterating ads based on results

- After Effects, Photoshop, Figma or graphic-design ability

- Experience with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, ElevenLabs, Runway, Descript or similar

- Familiarity with Airtable, 
, Slack or comparable production tools

- Experience creating multiple hooks or variations from one core concept



WHAT WE OFFER



- Fully remote, long-term work with a growing international team

- Monthly compensation in USD, with the range based on experience and demonstrated ability

- Exposure to real e-commerce brands and creative that runs in live ad accounts

- The chance to see what actually performs, rather than editing in a results vacuum

- Direct, useful feedback from experienced pod leads and creative strategists

- A clear path to grow into a senior editor, specialist editor or pod-lead position

- Opportunity to work across different products, audiences and creative formats

- A structured production system, clear briefs and defined QA process

- A team that values initiative, improvement and high standards

- Paid time off and local holidays, subject to the applicable contract

title: Creative Reviewer / Art Director – Facebook Ads, Amazon, Website & Social Media
description:
About WindRider



WindRider is a growing US outdoor apparel brand. We make rain gear, sun-protection shirts and cold-weather gear for people who fish and hunt. We sell through our own online store and on Amazon.



What makes us different: most of our first-draft marketing is now created by AI systems we've built. That includes Facebook and Instagram ads, videos, Amazon listing images, landing pages, website changes and social media posts. The AI is fast, but it doesn't have taste. That's where you come in.



The role



You'll be the human eye between our AI and our customers. Most days you won't design from scratch. You'll review what our AI produces, decide whether it's good enough, and give clear, specific feedback. That feedback improves the piece in front of you and also the system that made it.



  Think of it as part art director, part editor, part quality inspector.



Over time, as you prove your judgment, you'll move from first reviewer to final approver on more of our work.



What you'll do



Review AI-created work in Asana:

Facebook and Instagram ads (static images, carousels, video ads)

Other videos (social reels, product videos)

Amazon listing images, infographics and A+ Content

Landing pages and website changes

Social media posts

Approve it, reject it or request changes, with specific written notes. Not "make it pop," but "The headline competes with the product photo. Move the price under the button and make the button our brand blue."

For videos, give feedback on the hook, pacing, captions, music and message. No video editing required; we need your eye, not your editing skills.

Check every piece against our brand guide: fonts, colors, photo style and tone of voice.

Check Amazon images against Amazon's image rules and best practices.

Catch mistakes before customers see them: wrong product, wrong price, unsupported claims, typos, broken links, layouts that look bad on a phone.

Think like our customer, who is usually a man over 50 who loves fishing. Would this make him stop scrolling? Is the next step on this page obvious? What's stopping him from clicking "Add to Cart"?

Spot patterns in what the AI keeps getting wrong and write them up as clear rules, so the system stops repeating mistakes. This is the most valuable part of the job.

Make quick fixes yourself in Canva, Photoshop or Figma when that's faster than sending the work back.



You're a great fit if you have



A strong eye for design. You can look at an ad, a video or a webpage, see right away what's off, and explain why in words.

2+ years in graphic design, ad creative, web design or social media for e-commerce brands. Experience with performance ads that are judged on sales, not just looks, is a big plus.

An understanding of what makes ads and pages convert: a strong hook, clear visual hierarchy, customer reviews and other proof, an obvious call-to-action, and mobile-first layouts.

Hands-on skill in Canva plus Photoshop or Figma, enough to make quick edits yourself.

Excellent written English. Your feedback is the product, so it has to be clear and specific.

Comfort with AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, Canva AI, etc.), plus curiosity about them rather than fear of them.

Experience with Asana or a similar project management tool.

Obsessive attention to detail. You notice the typo, the misaligned button, the wrong product color. (To show us you read this whole post, start your application email with the word "Basecamp.")

Reliability: you meet deadlines and speak up early when you can't.



Bonus points



Experience with Amazon listing images, infographics or A+ Content

Experience with Shopify, Facebook Ads Manager or A/B testing

Experience with heatmap tools such as Microsoft Clarity or Hotjar

Experience writing creative briefs or brand style guides





This is NOT the right job if you want to spend your day designing from a blank canvas. If you'd rather direct and improve the work than make every piece yourself, keep reading.



How to apply (please follow every step; incomplete applications won't be reviewed)



  Email designer@windrider.com

  Subject line: Creative Reviewer – [Your Full Name] – [Your favorite outdoor activity]



  Include:



  1. Your resume or OnlineJobs.ph profile link.

  2. 3–5 samples of ads, Amazon images, landing pages or social posts you designed or art-directed, as links (Google Drive, Behance, Canva, etc.) set to "anyone with the link can view."

  3. A short critique (the most important part). Open windrider.com on your phone. Tell us 3 specific things you would change to get more visitors to buy, and why. Keep it under 250 words. Write it yourself; we're hiring your eye, not an AI's.

  4. Your availability: which hours (Philippine time) you can work each week, including confirmation that you can cover at least 2 hours of US morning time.

  5. A photo of your work setup and a screenshot of an internet speed test.



  Our hiring process



  1. We review applications. If you followed the steps above, you're already ahead of most applicants.

  2. Shortlisted candidates complete a paid test ($15): review 5 real pieces of AI-created work and write your feedback (about 1 hour).

  3. A 30-minute video call.

  4. Start with a 30-day trial period.

While traditional coach training focuses on teaching people how to coach, we focus on helping them build the business around their coaching skills.



We're creating a growing collection of online courses, masterclasses, practical resources and other learning experiences, covering topics such as marketing, branding, finance, business development, corporate coaching and much more.



One of our distinctive features is our AI-presented faculty: a cast of virtual educators, each with their own personality, expertise and teaching style. Behind them, however, is a human team researching, writing, designing and producing the educational content.



We're building an ambitious and slightly unconventional learning platform, with a strong emphasis on quality, creativity and practical value.



Our website is already substantially developed, our video production is underway, and we're now looking for a talented graphic designer to join our small creative team.







About the Role



We're looking for a graphic designer who can become our go-to person for visual design across the Studio.



This is a hands-on creative role involving everything from social media graphics and video thumbnails to website imagery, programme artwork and educational resources.



But we're also looking for something more than straightforward graphic production.



Although we already have a logo, website, typography and colour palette, we're still developing our wider visual identity. We have some ideas about the direction we'd like to take, but we're deliberately keeping an open mind.



Rather than commissioning a large branding exercise, we'd prefer to develop our visual style organically, through experimentation, discussion and the process of creating real content.



You'll work directly with the founder, exploring ideas, presenting alternative approaches and gradually helping us establish a distinctive and consistent visual language.



We want someone who enjoys both the creative thinking and the practical design work.



What You'll Be Doing



Social Media & Marketing Graphics



Creating engaging, distinctive visual content for our social media channels, including Instagram,
, LinkedIn and YouTube.



This could include:



- Standalone graphics that communicate an idea or insight.

- Carousel posts and visual storytelling.

- Illustrations, diagrams and conceptual graphics.

- Promotional images for courses and other Studio content.

- Graphics to accompany articles, essays and educational posts.

- Campaign visuals and advertising creatives.



We're particularly interested in graphics that communicate ideas intelligently, rather than simply decorating a quote or adding text to a stock photograph.



Website & Digital Design



Developing visual assets for our existing website and helping refine its visual presentation.



This may include:



- Imagery and illustrations for website pages.

- Visual identities for our different learning formats.

- Icons and supporting graphic elements.

- Programme artwork and promotional banners.

- Suggestions for improving the visual consistency and personality of the site.



We're not looking for someone to rebuild the website. The focus is on creating the visual assets and design treatments that make it more distinctive and engaging.



Video Thumbnails & Programme Artwork



Designing thumbnails and covers for YouTube videos, online courses, masterclasses and other educational content.



We want these to feel part of a recognisable Studio identity while giving individual subjects and faculty members their own character.



You'll work alongside our video production team to ensure a consistent approach across video and graphic content.



Educational Resources



Helping create visually attractive, clear and useful learning materials.



These may include:



- Workbook covers and internal page designs.

- Diagrams, models and frameworks.

- Worksheets, templates and downloadable resources.

- Presentation graphics.

- Supporting illustrations for educational content.



The emphasis will be on good information design, clarity and usability as well as visual appeal.



Developing Our Visual Identity



A particularly interesting part of the role will be helping shape the Studio's visual direction.



We don't expect you to arrive with a complete brand strategy or disappear for several weeks to produce a formal branding presentation.



Instead, we'd like to work collaboratively.



We might explore a particular illustration style, create several treatments of a website section, experiment with different approaches to course covers, or develop a family of graphics for our social media content.



Through this process, we'll identify what works, refine our preferences and gradually build a consistent visual identity.



Over time, we'd like you to help document the decisions we've made, creating a straightforward visual guide and reusable templates for the team.



Who We're Looking For



We're looking for a talented, imaginative graphic designer with strong visual judgement and a genuine interest in creative collaboration.



Ideally, you'll have:



- An excellent portfolio demonstrating strong graphic design skills.

- A good eye for typography, composition, colour and visual hierarchy.

- Experience creating content for social media and digital platforms.

- The ability to communicate ideas through illustrations, graphics and visual concepts.

- Experience creating coherent designs across different formats.

- Confidence using professional design tools such as Adobe Creative Cloud and/or Figma.

- The ability to develop ideas independently and present different creative options.

- Strong attention to detail and the ability to produce polished, finished work.

- An organised and reliable approach to managing ongoing assignments.



Experience with editorial design, educational content, brand design or information design would be particularly valuable.



We're also happy for you to use AI-assisted creative tools where they genuinely improve the work, provided you bring your own design judgement and attention to quality.



The Kind of Working Relationship We Want



We're a small team, and we work collaboratively.



You'll work directly with the founder, who is closely involved in the creative direction of the Studio, as well as alongside our video editors and content production team.



We're looking for someone who is comfortable with an iterative process: discussing an idea, producing a few approaches, getting feedback, refining the design and moving forward.



Sometimes we'll have a very clear brief. At other times, we'll have a half-formed idea and want your help developing it.



You should feel comfortable making suggestions, questioning an approach and proposing something better.



We value good creative judgement, curiosity, initiative and the willingness to experiment.



We also want someone who enjoys producing finished work. This isn't primarily a consultancy or brand strategy position. It's a creative production role with the opportunity to help influence the brand's direction.



What Success Looks Like



Over the first few months, we'd hope to see:



- A regular flow of high-quality visual content for our social media channels.

- An increasingly consistent and recognisable style across our visual materials.

- Stronger and more distinctive website imagery.

- A coherent approach to course covers and video thumbnails.

- A growing collection of reusable templates and design assets.

- A productive creative relationship in which ideas can be explored and developed quickly.



We expect our visual identity to become clearer through this process rather than trying to settle every decision before the work begins.

What We're Offering



This is an opportunity to become an important part of a growing creative and educational business.



You'll have the chance to contribute ideas, influence the development of the brand and see your work used across a wide range of channels and educational products.



We're interested in building a long-term relationship with the right person.



We're open to discussing the number of hours and working arrangements depending on your experience and availability.



How to Apply



Please send us:



1. Your portfolio, particularly examples of social media graphics, editorial design, digital graphics, illustrations or brand-related work.

2. A short introduction explaining what kinds of design work you particularly enjoy and why this role interests you.



We'd particularly like to see examples where you've taken a relatively simple idea and turned it into an original, engaging visual.



Please avoid lengthy, generic proposals and AI written smartly worded applications that I get 10 times per day. We'd much rather see a strong portfolio and a few thoughtful comments about how you like to work.



We're looking for someone who can help us create the Studio's visual identity by making things, experimenting and improving together.

title: Video Editor
description:
M I L K W I S E · J O B D E SCRIPT I O N

Video Editor

Social · Podcast · Video · Stills

Full-time independent contractor · Remote (Philippines) · Monthly fee · Reports to the VP Marketing



L O C A T I O N

hrs overlap with US afternoon); flexible

outside core hours



R E P O R T S  T O

Allie Fritsch, VP Marketing — working day to day

with the brand, podcast, and clinical team



S T A R T D A T E

October 2026

About MilkWise

MilkWise is a physician-supervised lactation and perinatal care practice. Our IBCLC

lactation consultants see new parents at home in California and virtually across the

United States, and — unlike almost everyone else in the category — the care is covered

by insurance. We are live in-network with UnitedHealthcare, Aetna, and Cigna, with Blue

Cross Blue Shield coming, and we have delivered more than 3,700 visits since launching

in late 2024. We are growing into doula, midwifery, pelvic floor, nutrition, sleep, and

postpartum mental health support.



Content is how we reach the two audiences that matter most to us: parents who don't

yet know that expert feeding support can be covered by their insurance, and lactation

consultants who want to join a practice that pays fairly and handles the billing. We are

launching a panel podcast for pregnancy through baby's first year, building an active

social presence, and partnering with creators. You will be the person who turns all of

that footage into finished work.



The role

You will be MilkWise's first dedicated editor and will own the post-production pipeline

end to end: short-form social video, our weekly podcast (full episodes and clips), longer-

form brand and educational video, and still image editing for social, web, and recruiting.

You'll work from a clear brand system (we have full guidelines, fonts, color palette, and

templates) and from raw footage delivered by our team and partners in the US.

Milk Bar Collective, Inc. d/b/a MilkWise · Video Editor Job Description · September 2026 1

milkwise



This is a hands-on, high-volume editing seat — not a strategy role. We are looking for

someone who is fast, has excellent taste, cares about telling parents' stories with

warmth and accuracy, and can run a repeatable weekly production calendar with

minimal supervision.



What you'll do

Social media video (≈40%)

● Cut 10–15 short-form vertical videos per week (Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube

Shorts) from podcast recordings, creator footage, clinician interviews, and UGC.

● Add on-brand captions, hooks, text overlays, b-roll, and light motion graphics;

format for each platform's specs and safe zones.

● Turn around same-day edits when a timely hook or trend calls for it.

Podcast (≈30%)

● Edit the weekly multi-camera panel episode (video + audio): sync cameras,

remove dead air and crosstalk, level and clean audio, add intros, lower-thirds,

chapter markers, and end cards.

● Produce the episode's clip package (6–10 clips), audiogram, YouTube thumbnail,

and show-notes-ready timestamps.

● Deliver platform-ready exports for YouTube, Spotify, Apple Podcasts, and social.

Long-form video (≈15%)

● Edit brand films, patient stories, educational explainers, clinician recruiting videos,

and event/conference recaps.

● Build and maintain reusable motion templates (intros, lower-thirds, transitions,

animated logo) in After Effects or Premiere.

Still image editing & graphics (≈15%)

● Retouch and color-correct photography for social, web, and print; build carousel

posts, quote cards, thumbnails, and story graphics from brand templates.

● Resize and adapt assets across formats and channels; keep the shared asset

library organized and named consistently.

Across everything

● Own the weekly post-production calendar and hit delivery deadlines without being

chased.

● Apply the MilkWise brand system rigorously — typography, palette, motion

language, tone.

● Route every piece featuring clinical claims or patients through our review process

before it ships (see below).

● Track what performs and bring ideas back to the team about pacing, hooks, and

formats.



Milk Bar Collective, Inc. d/b/a MilkWise · Video Editor Job Description · September 2026 2

milkwise



What we're looking for

Required

● 3+ years of professional video editing, including at least one year producing short-

form social content at volume for a brand, agency, or creator.

● Expert in Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve; strong in After Effects for motion

graphics and titles; fluent in CapCut for quick-turn vertical work.

● Confident audio editing and mixing (Adobe Audition, Descript, or Resolve Fairlight)

— podcast experience is a strong plus.

● Solid Photoshop and Lightroom skills for retouching and color; comfortable in

Canva and Figma for template-based graphics.

● Excellent written and spoken English; you can read a transcript and find the best

45 seconds, and you can write a caption that sounds like a person.

● A portfolio that shows range: something fast and punchy, something warm and

story-driven, and something clean and informational.

● Reliable high-speed internet, a capable editing machine, and a quiet place to work.

● Comfort working with the realities of birth, breastfeeding, and postpartum — our

footage is intimate and we treat it with respect.

Nice to have

● Experience with healthcare, wellness, parenting, or other regulated/sensitive

categories.

● Thumbnail design and YouTube packaging instincts.

● Familiarity with AI-assisted editing tools (auto-captioning, transcript-based cutting,

upscaling) and a view on where they help and where they don't.

● Basic color grading for multi-camera consistency.

Working with sensitive content

MilkWise is a medical practice, and our content is held to a higher standard than most

brands. Two things every editor here needs to internalize:

● Privacy. Patient privacy comes first. Nothing featuring a real patient, baby, or

family is published without a signed release on file, and we never include

identifiable details beyond what has been consented to. When in doubt, ask.

● Compliance. Our clinicians follow the IBLCE Code of Professional Conduct and



MilkWise honors the WHO International Code of Marketing of Breast-milk

Substitutes. In practice: no infant formula, bottle, or pacifier brands in our content,

no claims about products or outcomes that clinical review hasn't approved, and no

editing that changes the meaning of what a clinician said.

We'll train you on all of this. We just need you to care about it





Compensation & engagement terms

M O N T H L Y F E E

PHP 55,000 – 85,000, invoiced and paid

monthly, set by experience and portfolio

E Q U I T Y

None — this is a cash-compensated

contractor role

E N G A G E M E N T

Independent contractor agreement; you

are responsible for your own taxes,

insurance, and statutory contributions

S O F T W A R E

Adobe Creative Cloud and Descript

licenses provided; you supply your own

editing hardware

T I M E O F F

Flexible scheduling around Philippine

public holidays; planned time off agreed

in advance with the CEO

G R O W T H

First editing hire — path to Lead Editor as

the content team grows; 90-day check-in

and annual fee review



Send the following to 
 with the subject line "Video Editor — [Your

Name]":

● A link to your portfolio or reel.

● Three pieces you're proudest of — at least one short-form vertical video and at

least one long-form or podcast edit — with a sentence on what you contributed to

each.

● Your expected monthly fee (PHP) and earliest start date.

Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a paid, two-hour editing test using

MilkWise footage, followed by a video interview with our CEO and brand lead.

title: Video Editor – Fitness YouTube + Shorts/Reels/TikTok
description:
We're CreatorClone, a fitness-tech company. We're partnering with an established fitness creator (pro bodybuilder, large YouTube and Instagram audience) to scale up his content, and we need one editor who can do both of these:



1. Long-form YouTube: 1 to 2 videos a week, 12 to 25 minutes. Formats include teaching explainers, rankings, reactions and collabs with other creators. Cut for retention: tight pacing, B-roll, chapters, and graphics where they help.

2. Short-form: clip every long-form video, plus batch-filmed teaching segments, into 10 to 20 YouTube Shorts, TikToks and Instagram Reels a week. 9:16 reframing, clean captions, a hook in the first 2 seconds, and on-screen calls to action.



We want clean, restrained edits: no heavy sound effects or looped music. Taste matters more than effects.



We expect you to use AI tools (OpusClip, Submagic, Descript, CapCut, Premiere's AI features, whatever makes you fastest) for the mechanical work. What we're paying for is judgment: picking the moments that stop the scroll, and cutting so people watch to the end. Put the word "creator" somewhere in your application so we know you read this far.



How this works: we're reviewing portfolios first, then running a short paid test with a few shortlisted editors. You'll work alongside the creator's existing producer. The right person becomes ongoing and full-time.



To apply, send:

- 3 short-form clips you edited (links), with view counts if you have them

- 1 long-form YouTube video you edited (link)

- Which AI tools you use, and for which step

- Your time zone and weekly availability

- Your rate



Fitness content experience is a plus, not a requirement.
