title: DTC Meta Ads & Shopify Conversion Specialist — Supplement Brand
description:
We are launching a premium supplement brand through Shopify and are looking for an experienced, hands-on DTC marketer to take ownership of our Meta advertising and Shopify conversion funnel.



Our strategy is straightforward:
 and Instagram ads that drive customers to persuasive Shopify landing pages and convert them into buyers.



We need someone who can move the project forward independently, recommend what needs doing and execute with minimal supervision.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



• Launch planning: Research competitors, offers, landing pages and active Meta ads. Recommend positioning, bundles and creative angles.



• Shopify funnel: Build and optimize mobile-first landing/product pages using a suitable theme or page builder. Improve messaging, product presentation, FAQs, offers, bundles and checkout experience.



• Tracking: Configure or oversee Meta Pixel and Conversions API. Verify purchase events, values and event deduplication before launch.



• Meta advertising: Set up, launch, test and optimize
/Instagram purchase campaigns. Manage spending against agreed budgets, acquisition-cost targets and profitability goals.



• Creative testing: Develop concepts, hooks, ad copy and briefs. Coordinate creators/designers/editors, review their work and keep fresh creative variations moving.



• Specialist coordination: Identify when additional help is needed for advanced development, tracking,
 flows or creative production. Prepare clear briefs and manage delivery within approved budgets.



• Reporting: Provide a short daily progress/blocker update and a weekly summary of ad spend, CPA, ROAS, conversion rate, average order value and recommended next actions.



You will work with our existing VA, who supports product sourcing and operational coordination. Approved specialist freelancer fees, software and advertising spend are funded separately from your compensation.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



• Proven experience managing Meta purchase campaigns for Shopify ecommerce brands.

• Hands-on experience building or improving Shopify landing pages—not simply sending traffic to them.

• Strong understanding of margins, customer acquisition costs, creative testing and conversion tracking.

• Ability to prioritize, meet deadlines and communicate proactively.

• Supplement or wellness brand experience is strongly preferred.



BRAND REQUIREMENTS



Our marketing must be honest and use substantiated product claims. Our creative guidelines require male talent only and no women appearing in advertising images or videos. You must be comfortable following these guidelines and briefing creators accordingly.



INITIAL PRIORITIES



Review our launch plan, identify missing pieces, propose a practical timeline and testing budget, prepare the Shopify funnel, verify tracking and coordinate initial creatives. Launch campaigns once product availability and the agreed readiness checks are complete.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include:



Two relevant ecommerce case studies showing the product category, campaign dates, ad spend, CPA/ROAS and your exact responsibilities. Redacted evidence is welcome.



Links or screenshots of Shopify landing pages you personally built or improved, with conversion results where available.



Details of any supplement or wellness brand experience.



Which responsibilities you can execute yourself and which would require specialist support.



A brief outline of your first 30 days for a new supplement launch.



Your availability and expected monthly compensation for 20 hours/week.



Shortlisted applicants may be invited to a small paid practical assessment before an ongoing engagement.

title: Gaming Stream Clipper & Social Media Content Editor
description:
I’m looking for a creative, reliable, and detail\-oriented Gaming Stream Clipper to turn livestream recordings into engaging short\-form videos for TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and Instagram Reels\.



The ideal candidate can identify entertaining gaming moments, edit them into high\-quality clips, and publish content consistently to help grow an online gaming audience\.



This position involves video editing, content publishing, and basic performance tracking\.



## Responsibilities



- Review livestream recordings and identify funny moments, clutch plays, reactions, fails, and entertaining interactions\.

- Edit vertical videos, generally 15–60 seconds long, optimized for short\-form platforms\.

- Add captions, subtitles, zoom effects, sound effects, and transitions when appropriate\.

- Create engaging opening hooks, captions, titles, and relevant hashtags\.

- Publish approved content directly to assigned TikTok, YouTube, and Instagram accounts\.

- Maintain a consistent posting schedule and organize completed clips\.

- Track views, engagement, and follower growth and provide weekly performance reports\.

- Follow platform\-specific content policies and copyright guidelines\.

- Communicate regularly and meet agreed deadlines\.



## Requirements



- Experience editing short\-form videos, preferably gaming content\.

- Familiarity with TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and Instagram Reels\.

- Knowledge of CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, or similar editing software\.

- Ability to recognize engaging moments and understand social media trends\.

- Strong attention to detail and time\-management skills\.

- Reliable internet connection and consistent communication\.

- Ability to work independently and follow instructions\.



## Account Security & Confidentiality



The employer retains full ownership and administrative control of all social media accounts and published content\.



- Access will be provided only through available platform permissions or other approved, limited\-access methods\.

- The employee will not receive access to the employer’s primary
 account, passwords, recovery codes, or account recovery methods\.

- The employee may not change account ownership, passwords, recovery information, security settings, or administrative permissions\.

- The employee may not share account access with unauthorized individuals or connect unapproved third\-party applications\.

- All account access must be revoked or returned when employment ends\.

- Any suspected unauthorized access or security incident must be reported immediately\.

- All work produced for the position must be delivered to the employer and handled according to the agreed confidentiality and content ownership terms\.



## Work Schedule & Expectations



This is a remote position with an agreed posting schedule and weekly deliverables\. The initial workload and posting targets will be established during onboarding and adjusted based on content quality and performance\.



The candidate should be comfortable working independently while providing regular updates\.



## Compensation



Please include your expected monthly salary or rate in your application\. Compensation will be discussed based on experience, workload, editing quality, and posting responsibilities\.



## Application Instructions



To apply, please provide:



1. A brief introduction about yourself and your relevant experience\.

2. Links to three examples of short\-form videos you have edited\.

3. The video editing software you use\.

4. Your expected monthly salary\.

5. How many quality clips you can realistically produce per day\.

6. Your experience managing or publishing content on TikTok, YouTube, or Instagram\.

7. Your typical turnaround time for editing a clip\.



Applications without video editing samples may not be considered\.



I’m looking for someone creative, dependable, and interested in building a consistent long\-term working relationship\.

s and follow-ups.

title: Part-Time Retail Ad Production Designer + Merchandising QA
description:
We are an off-price retailer based in Columbus, Ohio. Nineteen stores. We sell closeouts, never-outs, and in-and-outs, and we put out a print circular every week.



Remote. 15 to 20 hours a week, ongoing. $15 to $45 an hour depending on experience.



The job



You build our weekly print circular. Four pages, 40 plus products. Some weeks there are two.



You work from our ad file, a working Excel sheet our buyers fill in: item, retail price, comparison price, UPC, vendor, image link. You pull from it, lay out the ad, and catch what is wrong before it prints.



This is not a job where someone hands you perfect copy, and you make it pretty. The file will have mistakes. Missing comparison prices. A UPC with no item attached. An image link pasted into the vendor column. A buyer types "24 pack" and the photo shows 12. Finding those and asking about them is the job, not extra credit.



We should not have to remind you to check the ad file.



Software



- Adobe InDesign, required. This is where the circular is built.

- Adobe Photoshop, required, for product-image prep and cleanup.

- Adobe Illustrator, useful but not required.

- Strong Excel skills, required.



You are stepping into an existing production system. We are not rebuilding it in Canva.



What you have to be good at



Excel. Not formulas and pivot tables, though those help. You have to be comfortable living in a messy spreadsheet and spotting what does not belong.



English, written and spoken, at a level where you can question a buyer about a product claim and be understood the first time.



Proofreading your own work. Nobody checks behind you.



Production design. Clean grids, accurate prices, and type that follows brand standards. We have a brand book, and you follow it.



Organized files. Another designer should be able to open your work and pick up the next issue.



What makes this work



You take direction. We move fast, and the ad changes.



You overlap with U.S. Eastern business hours for part of your week. Not all of it, but enough that questions get answered the same day.



You want to be a partner. The person in this seat talks to me every week. I want someone who sees a messy file and solves it.



AI experience is a plus, not a requirement. We want to automate parts of this, and you would help build that.



Nice to have



Retail, grocery, or weekly circular experience.



Review the application materials first



View pages from a recent ad and a sample of the file you would be working from here:





Look at both before you apply. If the file looks like a mess, that is the point.



To apply



Start your message with "I check the details."



Then answer three things:



1. A time a buyer or client gave you bad information. What did you do?

2. Something you fixed that nobody asked you to fix.

3. Looking at the sample file, what would you fix first?



Attach one ad or flyer you built. Print preferred.



Finalists do a paid test project: one real ad, paid at your rate.

title: Real Estate Virtual Assistant – Operations & Marketing
description:
Real Estate Virtual Assistant – Operations & Marketing



Full-Time | Work From Home | Philippines | Paid Training

40 Paid Hours Per Week | Long-Term Opportunity

Starting & Training Pay: $4.00–$6.50 USD per hour, depending on experience and skills.

Pay Schedule: Twice monthly, on the 1st and 16th.

Payment Method: Direct payment through Wise.

Paid Training: Training is paid at your agreed-upon hourly rate from your first day.

Compensation Review: After 90 days, based on performance, progress, and responsibilities.



Looking for a Job Where You Can Learn, Grow, and Build Valuable Skills?

We believe in investing in people, not just assigning them work. When someone joins our team, we don't simply hand them a list of tasks and expect them to figure everything out on their own. Training and professional development are an important part of how we work. We provide paid, hands-on training, one-on-one guidance, recorded tutorials, and ongoing support to help our team members develop new skills and become confident in their responsibilities.



We don't expect you to know everything when you start. We're looking for someone who enjoys learning, asks questions, takes initiative, and wants to grow professionally.



Our goal is to build a long-term working relationship where we invest in your development and you take pride in the work we accomplish together.



About Our Business



We are an established, growing New Jersey real estate business affiliated with LPT Realty, a national U.S. real estate brokerage. We're looking for one dependable, organized, and tech-savvy Virtual Assistant to help manage the behind-the-scenes operations of our real estate business.



This is not a cold-calling, sales, or customer service position.



Nearly everything we do involves computer systems, Google Workspace, real estate technology, digital marketing, and AI tools. You don't need to be an expert in real estate. We're looking for someone who already has a good foundation in computer systems, enjoys learning unfamiliar software, and wants to develop professionally. We provide paid training and are willing to invest in the right person.



What You Should Already Know



Google Workspace 

You should have practical experience using:

Google Sheets

Google Docs

Google Drive

Gmail

Google Calendar

Organizing digital files and information

Working with multiple browser tabs and online applications



Important: Our business uses Google Workspace exclusively. We do not use Microsoft Office for daily business operations.

You must be comfortable working within Google's applications rather than switching between Microsoft and Google platforms.



Computer & Technology Skills



We're looking for someone who:



Is comfortable using computer systems and web-based applications.

Can learn unfamiliar software through tutorials and practice.

Understands digital file management.

Can solve basic computer problems.

Can work with multiple applications throughout the day.

Has basic familiarity with Google Gemini, ChatGPT, or similar AI tools.

You do not need advanced technical training or programming experience.

We want someone who can learn new systems, apply what they've learned, and become increasingly independent.



Experience That Would Be Helpful



These skills are a bonus. You do not need to know all of them.

Real Estate

Previous administrative experience with a U.S. real estate business.

Familiarity with MLS systems.

Exposure to real estate listings or transaction coordination.

Bright MLS or another U.S. MLS system.

Follow Up Boss or another CRM platform.

Marketing & Business Systems

Social media scheduling

Digital marketing

Basecamp or other project management tools

Data management and reporting

Basic expense tracking

Additional Google Tools

Google Forms

Google Slides

Google Vids

Google Sites

Google Classroom

YouTube content management

Gemini within Google Workspace

If you've used any of these programs, we'd love to hear what you've created or accomplished with them.



What You'll Be Doing



Your responsibilities will grow as you complete training and become comfortable with our systems.



1. Real Estate Listings & Transactions



Help prepare real estate contracts and documents using approved templates for licensed agent review.

Prepare property descriptions and listing information.

Enter and maintain MLS listing information using authorized access and required approvals.

Track contract dates, transaction deadlines, and important documents.

Organize files and transaction checklists.

Coordinate administrative tasks with title companies, lenders, attorneys, and vendors.

Order listing marketing through our brokerage's systems.

Set up and manage digital listing marketing campaigns.



2. Google Workspace & Business Operations

Create and maintain Google Sheets reports.

Research recently sold properties and organize sales information.

Track business expenses and organize receipts.

Maintain Google Drive files and folders.

Manage calendars, deadlines, and project assignments.

Help create written procedures for recurring tasks.

Organize and improve digital workflows.



3. Marketing & Social Media

Create marketing materials using Canva.

Manage daily social media campaigns.

Prepare monthly real estate magazine advertisements.

Create monthly neighborhood mailers featuring recently sold homes.

Research home sales and prepare reports for local publications.

Coordinate local vendor advertisements.

Organize printing and Every Door Direct Mail (EDDM) campaigns.

Track marketing projects and deadlines.



4. Client Relationships & Events

Maintain accurate client information in our CRM.

Track birthdays, anniversaries, and home purchase anniversaries.

Use online greeting card services to prepare and schedule personalized cards.

Help coordinate client appreciation events.

Organize vendors, invitations, supplies, and event checklists.

You won't be expected to master all these responsibilities immediately.



We'll begin with tasks that match your current abilities and introduce additional responsibilities as you learn.



What We Offer



Paid Training & Career Development

We believe in investing in good people and helping them develop valuable skills.

We provide:

Paid training from your first day.

No fees for company-required training or software.

One-on-one Zoom training.

Recorded tutorials and training videos.

Training in U.S. real estate transactions and MLS systems.

Training in real estate marketing and CRM platforms.

Opportunities to expand your Google Workspace skills.

Training in Google Gemini, ChatGPT, and AI-assisted workflows.

Clear procedures and ongoing feedback.

A compensation review after 90 days.

Opportunities for increased responsibility and compensation as your skills develop.

We're looking for someone interested in learning and building a long-term career, not simply completing assignments.



Work Schedule

Full-Time | Monday–Friday | U.S. Eastern Time

Initial Training Period — Approximately 3 Weeks

7:00 AM–12:00 PM: Live Zoom training, demonstrations, and guided learning.

12:00 PM–1:00 PM: Unpaid meal break.

1:00 PM–4:00 PM: Beginning assignments, independent practice, and applying what you've learned.



All training and assigned work hours are paid.



Regular Schedule — Expected Beginning Around Week 4

8:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time

Some flexibility in starting times may be available within normal U.S. Eastern business hours, depending on business needs.

Daily Breaks

40 paid hours per week.



This position requires evening and overnight working hours in the Philippines. Your local schedule will shift by one hour when U.S. daylight saving time changes.

Please apply only if you can consistently work these hours.



Home Office & Computer Requirements



Because we work with multiple computer systems, reliable equipment and internet are important.

Recommended Computer Specifications

Intel Core i5 (10th generation or newer), AMD Ryzen 5 (4000 series or newer), or comparable processor.

16 GB RAM or more.

SSD storage.

Windows 11 or a currently supported version of macOS.

Ability to run multiple browser applications and Zoom smoothly.

Preferred Equipment

512 GB SSD.

Internet speeds of 100 Mbps download and 20 Mbps upload or faster.

Home Office

Reliable internet connection.

Backup internet or mobile hotspot.

Practical backup power plan.

Quiet, dedicated workspace.

Comfortable desk and chair.

Noise-canceling headset with microphone.

Webcam for Zoom meetings.



We're Looking for the Right Person, Not the Perfect Home Office

We understand that a great candidate may not have the latest computer, fastest internet, or most comfortable workspace.

Please don't let equipment limitations stop you from applying if you have the technical ability, willingness to learn, and qualities we're looking for.

For the right candidate, we're willing to invest in approved improvements, which may include:

Computer upgrades or additional equipment.

Faster internet service and Wi-Fi upgrades.

Backup internet solutions.

A comfortable office chair and desk.

An external monitor, quality headset, or other equipment needed to work efficiently.

We ask that you tell us honestly about your current computer, internet speed, and workspace so we can understand what you already have and what improvements may be needed.

Equipment and internet assistance will be discussed individually with selected candidates.



What matters most is finding someone dependable, technically capable, eager to learn, and interested in a long-term working relationship.



Computer Security & Time Tracking

We use a company-approved VPN when required and background time-tracking software to maintain accurate records of working hours for payroll.

The software operates quietly without recurring screenshot alerts or interruptions. It may capture periodic screenshots during agreed working hours.



We expect our team members to follow company security procedures and protect confidential business and client information.

Our time-tracking, monitoring, and privacy procedures will be explained before work begins.



Personal Qualities We Value

Technical skills are important, but we also care about how you work.



We're looking for someone who:

Is honest, dependable, and punctual.

Enjoys learning technology.

Has strong attention to detail.

Can follow instructions and established procedures.

Asks questions when something isn't clear.

Can work independently after receiving training.

Takes notes and learns from feedback.

Communicates openly when mistakes or problems happen.

Enjoys solving problems.

Takes responsibility for completing assignments.

Wants to learn and grow professionally.



We welcome suggestions and new ideas. We also believe in following established procedures unless changes have been discussed and approved.

We're looking for a long-term working relationship built on mutual respect, clear communication, and dependability.



How to Apply



Please copy the three questions below into your application and answer each one.



Begin with a brief introduction about yourself and your relevant work experience.



1. Technology & Real Estate Experience



Which Google Workspace applications have you used? What have you created or managed with them?



Have you worked with U.S. real estate, MLS systems, CRM platforms, or other online business software?



Please share specific examples.



2. Learning New Technology



Tell us about a computer program you had to learn from scratch.



How did you learn it, how long did it take, and what can you do with it now?



3. Home Office & Availability

Internet download and upload speeds.



Backup internet and power arrangements.



Workspace, desk, chair, headset, and webcam.



Please confirm that you can work both the initial training schedule and regular U.S. Eastern Time schedule.



Are you comfortable using a company-approved VPN and background time-tracking software during your scheduled working hours?



Tell Us About Your Skills



Please rate your current ability from 1–5.



1 = No experience | 2 = Beginner | 3 = Working knowledge | 4 = Proficient | 5 = Advanced



Google Workspace



Google Sheets



Google Docs



Google Drive



U.S. Real Estate



MLS Systems



Transaction Management



CRM Systems



Operations Management

Canva



Digital Marketing



Social Media Management



Basecamp



Google Gemini / ChatGPT

We Want to Hear Your Own Voice



We use AI in our business and appreciate its benefits. However, for your application, we'd like to hear directly from you, without AI-generated responses.



Please answer in your own words and share specific examples from your experience.



Your English doesn't need to be perfect. We're more interested in understanding how you think, what you've learned, and how you approach your work.

title: E-commerce Marketing Manager
description:
About the Role



EVORETRO is looking for a results-driven and strategic Marketing Manager to lead and oversee all end-to-end marketing operations across our e-commerce platforms, digital marketing channels, social media, paid advertising, influencer partnerships, and events.



This role is responsible for developing and executing marketing strategies aligned with the company's business goals, managing the performance of the marketing team, coordinating cross-functional initiatives, and ensuring that all marketing activities contribute to brand awareness, customer engagement, traffic, and revenue growth.



The ideal candidate is both strategic and hands-on, capable of leading a team of specialists, managing multiple marketing initiatives, monitoring performance metrics, and continuously improving marketing processes and results.



Key Responsibilities



 1. Marketing Strategy & Department Management

- Develop and implement comprehensive marketing strategies, campaigns, and initiatives aligned with company objectives.

- Oversee the entire marketing department, including planning, execution, performance monitoring, and reporting.

- Establish marketing goals, KPIs, budgets, priorities, and timelines for each function.

- Lead, supervise, and evaluate the performance of marketing team members and specialists.

- Manage workloads, delegate responsibilities, set priorities, and ensure timely completion of deliverables.

- Establish standardized workflows, processes, and reporting systems to improve departmental efficiency.

- Coordinate with executive leadership and other departments to align marketing initiatives with sales, product launches, and overall business priorities.



2. E-commerce & Marketplace Management

- Lead and oversee the performance of eBay and Walmart marketplace accounts, working closely with the E-commerce Account Specialists.

- Ensure effective marketplace strategies for product listings, promotions, pricing coordination, visibility, conversion, and sales growth.

- Monitor marketplace performance, product rankings, traffic, conversion rates, and revenue.

- Collaborate with the team on product launches, listing optimization, merchandising, and marketplace-specific campaigns.

- Coordinate with supply chain, inventory, and operations teams to support product availability and promotional planning.

- Identify opportunities to improve marketplace performance and expand the company's online sales channels.



3. Digital Marketing & Paid Advertising

- Supervise the Digital Marketing Specialist and oversee the execution of digital marketing campaigns.

- Lead marketing initiatives across Meta Ads and other relevant digital advertising channels.

- Monitor advertising budgets, campaign performance, return on ad spend (ROAS), customer acquisition cost (CAC), and conversion rates.

- Ensure campaigns are properly planned, tested, optimized, and aligned with business objectives.

- Oversee audience targeting, retargeting, campaign testing, and performance optimization.

- Use analytics and reporting tools to identify trends, evaluate campaign effectiveness, and recommend improvements.



 4. Social Media & Content Marketing

- Oversee social media strategy, content planning, publishing schedules, and audience engagement across relevant platforms.

- Guide the Social Media Specialist in creating content that supports brand awareness, product promotion, and customer engagement.

- Ensure consistency in brand messaging, visual identity, tone, and marketing communications.

- Coordinate content calendars, campaign assets, product announcements, and promotional activities.

- Monitor social media performance, audience growth, engagement rates, and referral traffic.

- Ensure social media initiatives support the broader marketing and e-commerce strategies.



5. Influencer & Partnership Marketing

- Lead the overall influencer marketing strategy, including creator identification, outreach, collaboration planning, and campaign execution.

- Oversee influencer partnerships, product seeding, sponsored content, affiliate initiatives, and brand collaborations.

- Establish campaign objectives, deliverables, budgets, and performance indicators.

- Monitor influencer campaign results, including reach, engagement, referral traffic, conversions, and revenue where measurable.

- Build and maintain relationships with influencers, content creators, and strategic marketing partners.



6. Shopify & Website Marketing

- Oversee Shopify-related marketing initiatives in coordination with the responsible team members.

- Ensure the website supports marketing campaigns, product launches, promotions, and customer acquisition goals.

- Monitor website traffic, conversion rates, customer behavior, and sales performance.

- Coordinate website content updates, landing pages, promotional banners, product merchandising, and conversion optimization.

- Identify opportunities to improve the customer journey, user experience, and online store performance.

- Collaborate with relevant teams on SEO,
 marketing, and customer retention initiatives, as applicable.



7. Events & Brand Activations

- Plan, coordinate, and oversee marketing events, trade shows, industry exhibitions, product showcases, and brand activations.

- Manage event objectives, budgets, timelines, logistics, promotional materials, and team assignments.

- Coordinate with internal departments, event organizers, vendors, influencers, and external partners.

- Ensure events support brand awareness, lead generation, partnerships, customer engagement, and sales opportunities.

- Evaluate event performance and prepare post-event reports with recommendations for future activities.



 8. Performance Monitoring & Reporting

- Establish and monitor KPIs for the marketing department and its individual functions.

- Consolidate reports covering marketplace sales, advertising performance, website conversions, social media engagement, influencer campaigns, and event results.

- Analyze marketing data to identify opportunities, challenges, and areas for improvement.

- Present regular performance updates, insights, and recommendations to executive leadership.

- Ensure marketing activities are evaluated based on measurable business outcomes, not just completed tasks.

- Recommend adjustments to strategies, budgets, and resource allocation based on performance data.



9. Cross-Functional Coordination

- Work closely with Sales, Supply Chain, Finance, Product, and executive leadership to align marketing activities with company goals.

- Coordinate promotional calendars, product launches, inventory availability, campaign requirements, and budget approvals.

- Ensure clear communication, accountability, and timely execution across marketing functions.

- Identify operational gaps and implement improvements to departmental processes and collaboration.



Qualifications & Requirements



- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field preferred.

- At least 5 years of relevant marketing experience, including experience managing marketing campaigns and leading people or teams.

- Proven experience overseeing multiple marketing functions, preferably in e-commerce, retail, consumer products, or a similar business environment.

- Experience with eBay and Walmart marketplace operations or marketplace account management.

- Strong understanding of digital marketing, paid advertising, Meta Ads, social media management, influencer marketing, and content strategy.

- Working knowledge of Shopify and e-commerce website performance optimization.

- Experience planning and managing marketing events, partnerships, or brand activations.

- Proficiency in marketing analytics, KPI tracking, budget management, and performance reporting.

- Strong leadership, project management, communication, and decision-making skills.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities, lead remote teams, and ensure accountability across different marketing functions.

- Data-driven mindset with a strong focus on business results, continuous improvement, and return on investment.



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)



Performance will be evaluated based on agreed targets, including:



- Marketing-attributed revenue growth and contribution to overall sales.

- E-commerce marketplace sales, conversion rates, and account performance.

- Paid advertising efficiency, ROAS, and customer acquisition cost.

- Website traffic, conversion rates, and Shopify store performance.

- Social media growth, engagement, and referral traffic.

- Influencer campaign performance and measurable business outcomes.

- Event execution, budget adherence, and lead or partnership generation.

- Achievement of marketing campaign deadlines, budgets, and objectives.

- Team productivity, quality of deliverables, and achievement of individual KPIs.

- Accuracy and timeliness of reporting and cross-department coordination.



Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate is a strategic marketing leader who understands how different marketing functions work together to drive business growth. They can guide specialists, establish clear priorities, manage budgets, interpret performance data, and take ownership of the department's overall results.



This person should be comfortable managing both the strategic direction and operational execution of marketing activities while building a collaborative, accountable, and results-oriented team.

title: Daily short-form video creator — ON CAMERA, fluent English (trading education)
description:
I run a
 channel where I share the trades I take in forex and gold, and explain the reasoning behind them. I am looking for ONE person to make and publish one short video per day.



READ THIS FIRST — it saves us both time:



You appear on camera yourself. This is not an AI video job. No AI avatars, no AI-generated UGC, no faceless voiceover over stock footage. If that is what you do, this is not the right job for you.



WHAT YOU WOULD DO

- One short video per day, 30-60 seconds, you on camera

- Topics and scripts come from me: what a stop-loss is, how leverage works, why gold moves on interest rate decisions, how to read an economic calendar, what a pip is

- Write the caption, publish it, keep an eye on the comments

- Roughly 20-25 videos per month



WHAT I NEED FROM YOU

- Fluent spoken English that an international audience follows easily

- Comfortable on camera, speaking to the lens

- You understand trading, or you are genuinely willing to learn it properly. You do not need to be a trader. You need to explain one concept clearly in 45 seconds.

- Your own phone, decent light, a quiet room. No studio needed.

- Reliable: one video per working day, not five in one burst and then nothing



WHAT I WILL NEVER ASK YOU TO SAY

- That results are guaranteed or risk-free, or that anyone will make money

- Any win rate, profit figure or income claim

- Anything you do not understand yourself



This is not a formality. Content like that gets accounts removed, and it is not how this brand works.



WHAT I OFFER

- Fixed monthly rate, paid on time, long term

- Scripts and topics from me; you make them yours

- One brand, one face, built up over months — not scattered one-off gigs



HOW TO APPLY — please read



Do not send a CV or a portfolio of unrelated work. Instead:



1. Record a 30-second video of YOURSELF explaining what a stop-loss is, as if telling a friend who has never traded. Phone camera is fine.

3. Tell me your monthly rate for about 25 videos a month.



Applications without the video will not be read.

title: EXPERIENCED STR OPERATIONS MANAGER
description:
Own Daily Operations, SOPs & Team Cadence (Hostaway)

 

Full-time | Starting at $600 USD per month | Monday–Saturday, flexible schedule

 

I run eight furnished short-term rentals in the United States. The units are profitable and we are ready to grow. We are hiring one person to own how the business runs, so that I can step back and the portfolio can scale.

 

This is NOT an entry-level role and NOT a general virtual assistant role. Please apply only if you have at least three (3) years of hands-on short-term rental operations experience, including coordinating cleaners and maintenance across multiple units and leading or supervising other people.

 

If you cannot work Saturdays, or cannot be reached when something urgent happens, please do not apply.

 

WORKING HOURS AND OWNER MINDSET

* Full-time, Monday to Saturday. Saturday is a working day.

* Your regular working blocks are agreed with us in week one and built around our team's coverage, so they can fit your life.

* Our virtual assistants cover guest messaging on two shifts across the US day and evening. You own everything behind them: turnovers, vendors, escalations, logs and procedures.

* This role needs an owner's mindset, not a clock-in mindset. Most days are steady; some have bursts. When something needs an owner (a missed turnover, a guest emergency, a vendor no-show), you are reachable and you handle it, including outside your usual blocks.

 

THE ROLE

You own operations end to end: everything that happens after a guest books. You report directly to the owner, who wants a short daily summary, not daily involvement. You work alongside our General Manager, who leads growth and new units. Your team is our virtual assistants (guest messaging), cleaners and handymen, coordinated mostly on WhatsApp and in Hostaway.

 

We have no consistently followed procedures today. Building them, and making them stick, is your first job.

 

YOU WILL OWN

1. Standard procedures. Write, train, enforce and spot-check: turnover and cleaning standard with photo proof, guest journey, escalation ladder, early check-in and late check-out, damage claims and review disputes, supplies.

2. Team cadence and accountability. Daily hand-in from the VAs, a check of arrivals, departures and turnovers, and an end-of-day summary to the owner and General Manager (exceptions and decisions only); weekly team review. A simple scorecard for every role (VAs, cleaners, handymen) with clear standards and consequences. Recruit, onboard and, when needed, replace team members with owner approval.

3. Tools and channels. Hostaway as the system of record: tasks, automations, message templates. Move coordination off WhatsApp wherever a tool does it better. Work with PriceLabs and our pricing agency on occupancy and rate. Help us add channels beyond Airbnb.

4. Maintenance and supplies. Every repair tracked to closure; a preventive-maintenance calendar per unit; par levels and reordering so nothing is discovered by a guest.

5. Compliance and unit economics. Permit tracker and renewal calendar; cleaner and handyman invoices reconciled against the turnover log before every payout; a monthly cost report by unit; early warning on any unit drifting toward break-even.

 

You are also the escalation point for the VAs on guest issues.

 

HOW DECISIONS WORK

You handle routine issues on your own. Above the spend limit we agree, or for safety concerns and serious damage, you take immediate protective action and bring in the owner with a clear summary and your recommendation. Your authority grows as your judgment is proven.

 

HOW YOU WILL BE MEASURED

A written scorecard, agreed in week one: turnovers completed on time with photo proof; issues closed within the agreed time; procedures live and followed; invoices reconciled before payout; owner time on daily operations down to about five minutes a day.

 

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

* 3+ years hands-on STR operations (Airbnb required)

* Coordinating cleaners and maintenance vendors for several units at the same time

* Having led or supervised a team

* Having written, rolled out and enforced checklists, SOPs or trackers

* A property management system such as Hostaway, Guesty, Hospitable or OwnerRez

* Comfortable with numbers: logs, invoices, simple cost reports

* Excellent written English; comfortable coordinating on WhatsApp

* A plus: Airbnb damage claims and review disputes, PriceLabs, Breezeway or similar task tools, smart locks

 

WHAT WE ARE REALLY LOOKING FOR

We do not want someone who forwards messages or waits for a task list. If a cleaner has not sent photos by the deadline, you chase before the guest arrives. If the log and an invoice do not match, you catch it. If a procedure is not being followed, you say so, politely and clearly, to whoever it is. You build the procedure, you train it, and you check it is followed. You think in systems, not just tasks.

 

DO NOT APPLY IF

* You need a script for everything

* You escalate every decision instead of making it

* You want to clock in, answer messages and clock out

* You are not comfortable holding colleagues to a standard

 

PAY

Starting at $600 USD per month, full-time. Final pay is discussed with shortlisted candidates, based on experience and scope.

 

HIRING PROCESS

1. Online application (about 35 minutes): short questions, one thing you have built, and a short voice note (a link, or a voice message, as the form explains)

2. If shortlisted: 20-minute call, including a live WhatsApp exercise

3. Final conversation with the owner (30 minutes)

4. Paid 30-day start against the written scorecard, then confirmed

 

HOW TO APPLY

Apply only through this form: 

We cannot review applications sent any other way. The first question asks you to type the words PROOF, NOT PROMISES, to show you read this post.

 

We would rather hear your own thinking than a model's. Your voice note must be in your own words, unscripted. If you use AI for the written answers, you must be able to explain every line live; we will test this.

title: Certified Affordable Housing Compliance Specialist (LIHTC, HOME, PSH)
description:
We are seeking an experienced, CERTIFIED Affordable Housing Compliance Specialist to independently manage compliance for properties funded through LIHTC (Low-Income Housing Tax Credit), HOME, and PSH (Permanent Supportive Housing) programs. This is NOT a training position. You must already know these programs well enough to complete forms and compliance tasks on your own, with minimal supervision.



REQUIRED CERTIFICATIONS (must have, no exceptions - please state your certifications and certification numbers/dates in your application):

- Housing Credit Certified Professional (HCCP) and/or Certified Occupancy Specialist (COS) or equivalent LIHTC compliance certification

- Certification in HOME program compliance (e.g., Certified Occupancy Specialist/HOME training or equivalent) 

- Other relevant certifications (e.g., SHCM, NAHP-COS, NAHP-CGPM, Fair Housing, HUD-recognized training) are a plus

Applicants without the required certifications will not be considered.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE:

- Minimum 3-5 years of hands-on experience in affordable housing compliance (more is preferred)

- Proven, direct experience with LIHTC, HOME, and PSH programs, including layered/multi-funded properties

- Expert knowledge of Section 42 / IRS rules, HOME regulations (24 CFR Part 92), HUD Handbook 4350.3 where applicable, and state housing finance agency requirements

- Strong understanding of Fair Housing, VAWA, and PSH/homeless program (CoC, HMIS-related) documentation requirements

- Experience with property management/compliance software such as Yardi, RealPage, Entrata, AppFolio, or similar, and with tracking tools such as TRACS/HDS or state agency portals



RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Review new move-in and annual/interim recertification files for accuracy and compliance

- Independently complete and review program forms: Tenant Income Certifications (TICs), Student Status certifications, Employment and Asset verifications, income and asset calculations, household eligibility determinations, and program-specific addenda

- Determine applicant/resident eligibility under income limits, rent limits, set-asides, utility allowances, and the Next Available Unit rule

- Track and maintain compliance for the applicable program rules, including HOME rent/occupancy rules and PSH eligibility and documentation (chronic homelessness verification, disability verification, referrals, etc.)

- Prepare for and respond to state agency, HUD, and investor audits and file reviews; prepare corrective action responses

- Complete annual owner certifications and compliance reports, and submit required reports to agencies and investors

- Conduct internal file audits and identify and correct deficiencies before agency monitoring

- Maintain organized, audit-ready electronic files and compliance calendars/deadlines

- Provide guidance and training to on-site property management staff on compliance matters

- Stay current on regulatory changes and communicate updates to the team



QUALIFICATIONS:

- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy with numbers and documentation

- Strong written and verbal English communication skills

- Able to work independently, meet deadlines, and manage multiple properties

- Proficient with Excel, Google Workspace/Microsoft Office, and PDF/e-sign tools

- Reliable high-speed internet and computer; comfortable working remotely

- Handles confidential tenant information with the highest level of discretion

- Availability to overlap with US business hours as needed



HOW TO APPLY:

Please include in your application: (1) a list of your current certifications with issuing organization and dates, (2) a summary of your years of experience with LIHTC, HOME, and PSH, including the types of forms and audits you have handled, and (3) your resume. Only candidates who meet ALL the required certification and experience criteria will be considered.

title: B2B Cold Caller & Appointment Setter – Commercial Cleaning
description:
Jay’s Janitorial Service LLC is a growing commercial cleaning company serving Nashville, Clarksville, and surrounding Tennessee and Kentucky communities. We are looking for a reliable, confident virtual sales assistant to help us reach business decision-makers and book qualified cleaning walkthroughs.



HOURS & PAY

• 30 hours per week, Monday–Friday, during U.S. Central Time business hours. Exact schedule agreed before starting; this will generally be an evening/overnight schedule in the Philippines.

• $5–$6 USD per hour based on experience, plus performance bonuses.

• $25 per completed qualified walkthrough with a decision-maker or authorized representative genuinely considering cleaning service.

• Recurring contract bonuses: $75 for contracts under $2,000/month; $125 for $2,000–$4,999/month; $200 for $5,000+/month. Contract bonuses are paid after the first customer payment.

• Start with a paid 30-day pilot, with the goal of a long-term working relationship.



RESPONSIBILITIES

• Call businesses, introduce our commercial cleaning services, identify decision-makers, and book walkthroughs for our owner.

• Research prospects including offices, medical facilities, warehouses, churches, retail locations, and property managers, with an emphasis on larger recurring contracts.

• Follow up by phone and
, confirm appointments, and maintain accurate CRM records.

• Record contacts, interest level, current cleaning arrangements, next steps, and appointment outcomes.

• Provide a brief daily activity report and participate in weekly performance reviews.

• Respect opt-outs and our existing-customer/do-not-contact lists.

• Expect approximately 20 hours of calls/follow-ups and 10 hours of research, CRM work,
s, and scheduling each week.



REQUIREMENTS

• Strong spoken and written English and a professional, friendly phone manner.

• Prior B2B cold calling, appointment setting, or outbound sales experience.

• Confidence reaching decision-makers, handling objections respectfully, and following up consistently.

• Organized, dependable, and comfortable using a CRM,
, and shared calendars. HubSpot experience is a plus.

• Reliable computer and internet, a quality headset, and a quiet workspace.

• Commercial cleaning or facilities-services sales experience is helpful but not required.



We will provide company information, initial scripts, service-area guidance, and access to the calling platform, CRM, and scheduling tools. You will book walkthroughs; the owner will handle site visits, pricing, and closing.



HOW TO APPLY

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph with:

1. A short summary of your B2B calling and appointment-setting experience.

2. Your resume or relevant work history.

3. A 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself and giving a sample opening call to an office manager about commercial cleaning.

4. Your availability in U.S. Central Time, preferred hourly rate within the range, and earliest start date.

5. Any results you can share from prior campaigns, such as qualified appointments booked.



Please include “Jay’s Appointment Setter” in your application subject.

title: Supply Chain and Logistics Assistant
description:
Who We Are



Brida is a fast-growing eCommerce brand built by founders who scaled the company to seven figures per month within just two months. We are now building our operations team and looking for people who want to grow with us and help shape the next phase of this company.



We move fast, our order volume keeps growing, and we reward people who take their craft seriously. As we expand our product line, keeping the right stock in the right place at the right time is the next big unlock for our business, and we need the right person to help us get it right immediately.



If you want to keep a fast-growing brand running smoothly, build something from scratch, and grow into a supply chain leadership role, this is your seat.





The Purpose of This Role



The purpose of the Supply Chain and Logistics Assistant at Brida is to keep our inventory accurate, our shipments on time, and our customers receiving their orders without delays.



As our Supply Chain and Logistics Assistant, you will track product from our suppliers to our warehouse to our customers. We are looking for someone organized and detail-oriented who catches problems early and follows up until every issue is closed.



This role goes beyond data entry. You will also flag stock risks before they happen, catch cost errors, and help us build cleaner systems as we scale.





What You Will Do



Onboarding



Learn Brida's products, order flow, and fulfillment process before managing a single shipment

Review current stock levels, past shipments, and supplier timelines

Get familiar with our inventory sheets, Checkout Champ, and fulfillment partner tools



Ongoing Responsibilities



Track inventory levels daily and flag low stock early

Update and maintain inventory and reorder sheets

Track inbound shipments from supplier to warehouse

Coordinate with suppliers and our fulfillment partner on orders and deliveries

Check fulfillment and shipping invoices for accuracy

Support lost, damaged, and reship cases with the customer support team

Report stock levels, shipment status, and issues weekly





What We Are Looking For



Required Experience



1–2 years in supply chain, logistics, or operations support for eCommerce/DTC

Strong Google Sheets or Excel skills (non-negotiable)

Experience tracking inventory and shipments

Experience working with suppliers or a 3PL/fulfillment partner

Strong attention to detail and accuracy with numbers

Excellent written English



Strong to Have



Health/wellness or supplement experience

Experience with Checkout Champ or Shopify order management

Experience with overseas suppliers or international shipping



Character Traits We Hire For



Organized and detail-oriented

Fast, reliable, and accountable

Coachable and feedback-driven

Strong communicator





This Is NOT For You If



No eCommerce or logistics experience

You don't like spreadsheets or reconciling numbers

You need someone to chase you for updates

You're uncomfortable following up with suppliers on deadlines

You want low accountability





Hours and Location



Fully remote

Work from anywhere in the world

Monday to Friday, flexible hours

We care about output, not clock-watching.

Salary: $4 per hour





Growth Potential



At Brida we highly value growth and development in all areas. With great performance the potential for you as a Supply Chain and Logistics Assistant is significant:



Supply Chain Coordinator role with ownership over inventory planning and reorders

Logistics Lead role to manage fulfillment partners and shipping operations

Growth opportunity into a Supply Chain Manager role for high performers with strong ambition



Strong performers grow here. There is no ceiling for people who consistently deliver.





How to Apply



To confirm you have read the full post and are serious about this position please send an application message that includes all of the following:



Your updated resume

The inventory, shipping, and spreadsheet tools you have used

Your answer to this: "A product sells 40 units per day, we have 1,200 units in stock, and new stock takes 21 days to arrive. When should we reorder, and why?"

A 2 to 3 minute Loom video with your camera on, introducing yourself and your customer support experience (record free at 
) 



Only applicants who include a Loom video will be shortlisted.

title: Application Specialist
description:
Position Overview: 



The Application Specialist is responsible for testing, troubleshooting, and updating the internal apps, automations, and workflows Power Plus Systems develops, making sure each one is reliable, easy to use, and ready for rollout. This role works closely with the Operations Manager and Data Specialist, partners with the Process Specialist to make sure every new application or update process is documented before rollout, and collaborates with Admin Operations, Scheduling, Finance, Estimating, and Field teams to find issues before team members do and turn feedback into improvements. The ideal candidate has a software development background, hands-on experience using Claude and other AI tools, a working knowledge of webhooks and integrations, and a strong eye for user interface and user experience design. 



Pay Range: $8 per hour based on experience with a performance review scheduled after 90 days of employment. We believe in rewarding exceptional talents. 





About Power Plus Systems: 



Power Plus Systems LLC has been a dominant force in the residential electrical contracting industry for two decades, and we continue to lead the way. Our vision is to successfully wire 28,000 homes to completion by the year 2029, ensuring safe and efficient electrical solutions, thereby making a positive impact on the lives of our customers and communities. At Power Plus Systems, LLC, a position with us isn't just a job; it's an opportunity to grow and develop within a company that genuinely appreciates your contributions and dedication to our shared mission. 





Objectives: 



- Test company apps, automations, and workflows before rollout to confirm they work as intended across devices, browsers, and real-world scenarios.

- Perform manual testing and support automated testing to catch bugs, broken logic, and edge cases early. 

- Troubleshoot issues reported by team members, identify the root cause, and coordinate fixes with the Operations Manager and Data Specialist. 

- Test and monitor webhooks and integrations between systems such as GoHighLevel, Make, 
, Claude, Jotform, and other company platforms to ensure data passes correctly. 

- Review apps from the user's point of view and recommend and implement UI and UX improvements that make tools easier, faster, and clearer for team members. 

- Use Claude and other AI tools to speed up test case creation, debugging, documentation, and app updates. 

- Apply approved updates and improvements to existing apps and workflows, then retest to confirm nothing else broke. 

- Work with the Process Specialist to make sure every new application or update process is documented before rollout, and maintain test checklists and release notes so every rollout is consistent and repeatable. 





Competencies: 



- Solid understanding of software development concepts, including front-end and back-end logic, APIs, and how data moves between systems. 

- Hands-on experience using Claude and other AI tools in daily work, with the judgment to verify AI output before relying on it. 

- Working knowledge of webhooks, including how to read payloads, interpret response codes, and troubleshoot failed connections. 

- Familiarity with manual and automated testing methods, test cases, and regression testing for apps and workflows. 

- Strong eye for design with a clear understanding of user interface (UI) and user experience (UX) principles. 

- Analytical, detail-oriented approach to finding root causes rather than surface-level fixes. 

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues to non-technical team members. 

- Ability to manage multiple testing and update projects at once while meeting rollout deadlines. 

- Comfort using browser developer tools and automation platforms such as Make or Zapier is a plus. 

- Construction, electrical, or trade-industry experience is a plus. 





Education and Experience: 



- Background in software development through a degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience. 

- At least 2 years of experience in software development, QA testing, application support, or a related role. 

- Experience testing web apps, mobile apps, or automated workflows before release. 

- Experience working with webhooks, APIs, or system integrations. 

- Proven experience using Claude or other AI tools in a professional setting. 

- Experience with UI/UX design, design reviews, or tools such as Figma is a plus. 

- Experience with GoHighLevel, Make, 
, Claude, or similar business platforms is a plus. 





Equipment Requirements: 



- Computer or laptop capable of running multiple browsers, testing tools, and collaboration platforms at the same time. 

- Smartphone for testing mobile versions of company apps. 

- Stable and reliable internet connection for online operations and virtual communication. 





Physical Requirements: 



- Extended periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer. 





Benefits: 



- Growth opportunities in a well-established company. 

- Ongoing training and professional development opportunities. 

- Opportunity for advancement within the company. 

- A supportive and collaborative work environment. 

- Company-observed paid United States holidays (full time). 



Paid vacation (full time). 





How to Apply: 



If you are ready to join Power Plus Systems, LLC, a well-established residential electrical contractor that values its team members and offers excellent benefits, please submit your application through the link below. 




/internationalform 



Power Plus Systems, LLC is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds to apply. 



Join us at Power Plus Systems, LLC, and be part of our continued success as we embark on the next 20 years of excellence in residential electrical contracting!

title: Application Specialist
description:
Position Overview: 



The Application Specialist is responsible for testing, troubleshooting, and updating the internal apps, automations, and workflows Power Plus Systems develops, making sure each one is reliable, easy to use, and ready for rollout. This role works closely with the Operations Manager and Data Specialist, partners with the Process Specialist to make sure every new application or update process is documented before rollout, and collaborates with Admin Operations, Scheduling, Finance, Estimating, and Field teams to find issues before team members do and turn feedback into improvements. The ideal candidate has a software development background, hands-on experience using Claude and other AI tools, a working knowledge of webhooks and integrations, and a strong eye for user interface and user experience design. 



Pay Range: $8 per hour based on experience with a performance review scheduled after 90 days of employment. We believe in rewarding exceptional talents. 





About Power Plus Systems: 



Power Plus Systems LLC has been a dominant force in the residential electrical contracting industry for two decades, and we continue to lead the way. Our vision is to successfully wire 28,000 homes to completion by the year 2029, ensuring safe and efficient electrical solutions, thereby making a positive impact on the lives of our customers and communities. At Power Plus Systems, LLC, a position with us isn't just a job; it's an opportunity to grow and develop within a company that genuinely appreciates your contributions and dedication to our shared mission. 





Objectives: 



- Test company apps, automations, and workflows before rollout to confirm they work as intended across devices, browsers, and real-world scenarios.

- Perform manual testing and support automated testing to catch bugs, broken logic, and edge cases early. 

- Troubleshoot issues reported by team members, identify the root cause, and coordinate fixes with the Operations Manager and Data Specialist. 

- Test and monitor webhooks and integrations between systems such as GoHighLevel, Make, 
, Claude, Jotform, and other company platforms to ensure data passes correctly. 

- Review apps from the user's point of view and recommend and implement UI and UX improvements that make tools easier, faster, and clearer for team members. 

- Use Claude and other AI tools to speed up test case creation, debugging, documentation, and app updates. 

- Apply approved updates and improvements to existing apps and workflows, then retest to confirm nothing else broke. 

- Work with the Process Specialist to make sure every new application or update process is documented before rollout, and maintain test checklists and release notes so every rollout is consistent and repeatable. 





Competencies: 



- Solid understanding of software development concepts, including front-end and back-end logic, APIs, and how data moves between systems. 

- Hands-on experience using Claude and other AI tools in daily work, with the judgment to verify AI output before relying on it. 

- Working knowledge of webhooks, including how to read payloads, interpret response codes, and troubleshoot failed connections. 

- Familiarity with manual and automated testing methods, test cases, and regression testing for apps and workflows. 

- Strong eye for design with a clear understanding of user interface (UI) and user experience (UX) principles. 

- Analytical, detail-oriented approach to finding root causes rather than surface-level fixes. 

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues to non-technical team members. 

- Ability to manage multiple testing and update projects at once while meeting rollout deadlines. 

- Comfort using browser developer tools and automation platforms such as Make or Zapier is a plus. 

- Construction, electrical, or trade-industry experience is a plus. 





Education and Experience: 



- Background in software development through a degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience. 

- At least 2 years of experience in software development, QA testing, application support, or a related role. 

- Experience testing web apps, mobile apps, or automated workflows before release. 

- Experience working with webhooks, APIs, or system integrations. 

- Proven experience using Claude or other AI tools in a professional setting. 

- Experience with UI/UX design, design reviews, or tools such as Figma is a plus. 

- Experience with GoHighLevel, Make, 
, Claude, or similar business platforms is a plus. 





Equipment Requirements: 



- Computer or laptop capable of running multiple browsers, testing tools, and collaboration platforms at the same time. 

- Smartphone for testing mobile versions of company apps. 

- Stable and reliable internet connection for online operations and virtual communication. 





Physical Requirements: 



- Extended periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer. 





Benefits: 



- Growth opportunities in a well-established company. 

- Ongoing training and professional development opportunities. 

- Opportunity for advancement within the company. 

- A supportive and collaborative work environment. 

- Company-observed paid United States holidays (full time). 



Paid vacation (full time). 





How to Apply: 



If you are ready to join Power Plus Systems, LLC, a well-established residential electrical contractor that values its team members and offers excellent benefits, please submit your application through the link below.

title: Head of Growth (Remote) — UK E-commerce Brand
description:
About us

We’re a fast-growing UK e-commerce brand making custom products for tradespeople and small businesses. We make everything in our own UK workshop, lead our category, and have thousands of happy customers. We run a high-volume paid social creative engine and we’re expanding into the US.



The role

We’re looking for an innovator to own growth. You’ll come up with the ideas, test them fast, and scale what works. You’ll lead creative strategy, direct our in-house content creator on shoots, and build and manage a team of editors under you. You’ll work closely with our founder and our media buyer.



What you’ll do



Own the creative strategy for Meta, TikTok and Instagram: hooks, concepts, angles and offers

Write clear video briefs and direct shoots remotely with our on-site team

Run a constant testing pipeline, cut losers quickly and scale winners

Build, hire and manage a team of video editors

Read the data with our media buyer and turn it into the next round of creative

Bring new growth ideas beyond ads, such as
, organic, partnerships and new channels

Help shape the creative approach for our US launch

Experience running high-volume creative testing

Fluent written and spoken English

Able to work at least 4 hours a day overlapping with UK business hours

Experience with UGC, rage bait and personality-led content

Experience launching a brand in the US

Hands-on editing or motion skills

Excellent communication and relationship-building skills

Desirable



Experience recruiting affiliates from scratch or scaling a programme

Knowledge of performance marketing channels (SEO, paid media, content)

Familiarity with tracking, attribution, and conversion optimisation

Experience working in a marketplace or platform-based business



What We’re Looking For



A commercially driven mindset with a focus on measurable results

Someone who is both strategic and hands-on

A natural relationship builder who can engage and influence partners

Curious and proactive. Always looking for new growth opportunities



What We Offer



Flexible, remote working

Opportunity to shape and grow the affiliate channel

A collaborative and supportive team environment

Performance-based incentives tied to programme growth

Please send your CV along with a short note outlining:

Your experience with affiliate platforms (e.g. Awin)

A successful affiliate campaign or programme you’ve managed

How you would approach growing an affiliate programme from its current stage

title: Podcast Production Assistant (Riverside), $5 per episode, room to grow
description:
About us

UpFounders is a small AI automation agency. We run the UpFounders Podcast, where we interview founders and business owners. We’re looking for a reliable assistant to handle post-production for each episode.



What you’ll do (per episode, 20 - 30mins long; all content generation can be done within Riverside)



Clean up the recording in Riverside: remove filler words, long pauses, false starts and dead air, and apply audio enhancement

Make sure the layout is clean, with no cropped faces and both speakers framed well

Simple, straightforward edits only, no special effects or motion graphics

Create a YouTube thumbnail following our brand template

Write a LinkedIn post, plus short versions for other platforms, to promote the episode

Hand everything back for approval before anything is published



All editing happens inside Riverside. You’ll get your own editor access and a written checklist to follow.



Pay



$5 per completed episode (edit, thumbnail and social posts)

Paid per episode after approval



Room to grow

We’re a small team and growing. As volume increases, we plan to give more work to whoever proves reliable here: short clips, scheduling, guest follow-up
s and general virtual assistant tasks, with more hours and higher pay.



You’re a good fit if you:



Have used Riverside or a similar text-based editor (Descript, etc.)

Can make a clean, simple thumbnail in Canva or similar

Write clear, natural English for LinkedIn

Follow a checklist carefully and deliver within 48–72 hours



To apply:



Start your application with the word “UPFOUNDERS” so we know you read this.

Share 1–2 samples of podcast or video edits or thumbnails.

Tell us how many episodes per week you could handle.



Shortlisted candidates will do one paid test episode.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

title: Long-Form Video Editor Wanted (YouTube + Reels)

Approximately 9 long-form YouTube videos per month (typically 10 to 15 minutes each)

Approximately 10 short-form reels per month, mostly cut from the same long-form footage you'll already be working with

Three content styles you'll need to handle:

Pokemon collecting: cute, girly, energetic. Bright, playful, light effects, fun pacing

Fitness/wellness: punchy, slightly comedic, tight cuts, good sound design

Fashion/makeup/lifestyle/vlog: clean, aesthetic, cinematic vlog feel

A clear deliverable target and upload date

Feedback batched into one revision pass per project (no piecemeal nitpicking)

Comfort in at least one of: CapCut, Premiere Pro, or DaVinci Resolve (whichever you're fastest in is fine)

Budget: $700 to $810 USD/month starting, for the volume above

Monthly rate reviewed and increased as the channels scale. Long-term editors will have first opportunity to take on a lead editor role as additional editing support is added.

Async-friendly. You don't need to be online during my Vancouver hours. Please respond within 24 hours on weekdays. For items I flag as URGENT in the message subject, please reply same-day.

Paid trial first: one long-form edit and one reel cut from that footage. If the trial goes well, we move into ongoing monthly work.

A link to your portfolio or 2 to 3 examples of long-form editing work you've done (YouTube videos preferred)

WHAT YOU'LL BE SELLING



Our AI Receptionist service is designed to help local businesses respond to incoming calls when their staff are busy, unavailable, or outside normal business hours.



Depending on the customer's configuration, the system may be able to:



- Answer incoming calls using AI.

- Respond to frequently asked questions.

- Collect customer contact details and service requests.

- Help qualify potential leads.

- Transfer calls or send notifications when configured.

- Support appointment scheduling when the required integration is available.



Our initial target market is independent HVAC contractors and home service businesses in the United States.



These businesses can miss valuable inquiries when technicians are working, driving, or assisting customers.



Our objective is to help them capture more opportunities and improve their responsiveness.



OUR STANDARD OFFER



Setup fee: $497 + Monthly subscription: $297



The setup fee and first month's subscription total $794 before any applicable taxes or additional agreed charges.



We will provide product demonstrations and clear documentation so you understand what the service can and cannot do before presenting it to prospects.

You will:



- Contact business owners and decision-makers.

- Present our offer in clear, non-technical language.

- Ask questions to understand the prospect's call-handling process.

- Conduct sales conversations and product demonstrations using our materials.

- Handle objections about pricing, reliability, and implementation.

- Follow up with interested prospects.

- Close deals and guide customers through our secure payment process.

- Share feedback about objections and customer needs.



You are not expected to provide technical support or configure the AI receptionist after the sale.



COMPENSATION



Base pay: $3.00 - 5.62 USD per hour, depending on experience.



Commission: 15% of the first payment successfully collected for each new customer you close.



For example, if a customer pays the full $794 setup fee and first month, the commission would be $119.10, in addition to your hourly pay.



Commissions are paid after the customer's payment has been received and confirmed, according to the written agreement. Refunds and chargebacks will be handled according to the agreed terms.



The commission applies to the first payment only; recurring monthly subscription payments do not generate additional commissions under this initial compensation structure.



We aim to build a long-term team and may review compensation as the business grows and performance is demonstrated.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



You should:



- Have previous B2B sales or closing experience.

- Speak clear, professional English.

- Be comfortable speaking with US business owners.

- Have experience selling services, SaaS, or business solutions.

- Be able to explain a technical product in simple business terms.

- Be comfortable asking for the sale and handling objections.

- Understand follow-up and pipeline management.

- Be coachable, reliable, and organized.

- Be comfortable working toward measurable sales targets.



Experience selling to HVAC contractors, plumbers, electricians, pest control companies, or other home service businesses is a strong advantage.



Experience selling AI solutions is helpful but not required if you have a proven record of selling business services.



INITIAL PAID TRIAL

The selected candidate will begin with a paid trial of up to 8 hours. We will evaluate product understanding, communication, sales conversations, objection handling, follow-up quality, and overall fit before deciding whether to continue.

- Your approximate monthly sales results or conversion rates in previous roles.

- Your experience selling recurring services or SaaS.

- Your availability and earliest start date.

- A short voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you would be a good fit.
