title: Copywriter
description:
Cellexia Labs currently serves customers in markets all over the world, with our fastest-growing communities in Europe, the US, Canada, and Australia. We're a fully remote, international team, small by design, where everyone owns something real and decisions are made by the people closest to the work.



You'll write the copy that sits at the center of our growth. It's work that goes live quickly and is measured by real results, so you'll know what worked within days.



For a gifted writer who's fascinated by persuasion and wants their work judged by results, this is a rare opportunity: ownership of the voice of a growing brand.



A few examples of your responsibilities



Write words that move people. Stories and copy that pull a skeptical reader in, build belief, and move them to act. You'll lead with the angle, the hook, and the proof that earn the click and the order.



Script video that holds attention. Write the scripts for the videos that carry our brand: the hook in the first seconds, the story that keeps people watching, and the line that closes it.



Own the brand voice. Make Cellexia Labs sound like itself everywhere a customer meets us: confident, clear, and credible.



Turn insight into messaging. Dig into customer reviews, support conversations, and ingredient science to find the language customers actually use, then build every piece around it.



Make complex things simple. Take formulation details and ingredient science and turn them into benefits a customer understands in seconds, while staying accurate and compliant.



Test relentlessly. Ship variations of angles, hooks, and openings, read the results with the marketing team, and double down on what wins. Your best work is the work the data backs.



What we look for



Command of the craft. You write sharply and clearly, and you can tell a line that lands from one that merely sounds good. You edit your own work hard.



A pull toward persuasion. You're fascinated by what makes people say yes: the customer's doubts, the offer, the proof, the words that earn trust. You don't need a background in sales or persuasion. You need real curiosity about how words move people, and the drive to learn from what the numbers tell you.



Ownership. You treat every piece of copy as yours until it performs. You hold yourself to a bar that keeps rising.



Curiosity. You research before you write. You're willing to understand ingredients, customers, and competitors until the words come from real understanding.



Team spirit. You support the best idea, not your own. You take feedback well and give it generously.



Relevant experience. [2+] years of professional writing, with a portfolio that shows it. Experience in beauty, skincare, or other consumer brands is a strong advantage. Excellent written English is essential.



What we offer



Fast decisions, minimal bureaucracy. You'll never wait on a chain of sign-offs. Your ideas are taken seriously here, whatever your title or tenure, and the best ones get tested.



Competitive pay, set for where you live. We pay well above local market norms.



Yearly bonuses of up to 40% of your annual salary. When the brand grows, you share in it.



Monthly and yearly subsidies to do your best work. Every month, we put money toward the things that make you more productive: wellness, focus, hardware and internet upgrades, and more. You know what you need better than we do, so you d
 how to use it.



Impact you can see. Copy goes live fast here, and results come back quickly. You'll watch your words move the numbers.

A small team that moves fast. Good ideas get tested quickly.



Work from anywhere. Fully remote, with an international team and the flexibility that comes with it.



A path that grows with the company. As Cellexia Labs scales, the writer who shapes our voice is the writer best placed to lead it.



The selection process



We care about what you can do, not how polished your CV looks. That's why our process is built around how you think and work, not just where you've worked.



Step 1: Apply. Submit your application and CV through this link: 

Step 2: Online assessments. Right after you apply, you'll take two short tests: a problem-solving test and a personality test. The problem-solving test shows us how you reason through unfamiliar challenges. The personality test helps us understand how you work and whether the way we operate will suit you.

Step 3: Interview. If your results stand out, we'll invite you to interview with the team.



We move quickly. The whole process, from application to interview invitation, takes a couple of days.

If you like the role and believe you could excel at it, don't talk yourself out of applying. A less conventional background is welcome here if your results speak for themselves.



Before you apply



Cellexia Labs is a demanding environment. We hold ourselves to a high bar, and we ask the same of the people who join us. In return, you get real freedom, work that goes live, and a front-row seat to the growth of a brand.



If this sounds like the work you want to be doing, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply here:

description:

We are a health and wellness brand serving people aged 50 and above, and we are now building our customer support team with people who want to grow with us and help shape the next phase of this company.

We move fast, our order volume keeps growing, and we reward people who take their craft seriously. Every customer who reaches out to us is someone looking for relief and comfort in their daily life. How we respond matters.

If you want to make a real difference for customers, build something from scratch, and grow into a support leadership role, this is your seat.



The Purpose of This Role



The purpose of the
 Customer Support Agent at Brida is to give every customer a fast, clear, and caring experience through
.

Ongoing Responsibilities

Reply to customer
s quickly, clearly, and with empathy

Manage subscription changes and cancellations with retention in mind Answer product questions using approved information only, never medical advice

Escalate complex cases and chargebacks to the right team

Tag tickets and keep saved replies up to date

Report recurring issues and customer feedback weekly 



What We Are Looking For



Required Experience



1–2 years of
 customer support for eCommerce/DTC brands

Excellent written English with a warm, professional tone

Experience with Gorgias

Experience handling refunds, returns, and order issues in Shopify

Ability to manage high ticket volume without losing quality

Strong attention to detail and accuracy



Strong to Have



Health/wellness or supplement brand experience

Experience supporting older customers

Character Traits We Hire For

Patient, empathetic, and calm under pressure

Fast, reliable, and accountable

Coachable and feedback-driven

Strong communicator



This Is NOT For You If



You have no eCommerce customer support experience

You want low accountability



Hours and Location



Fully remote

Work from anywhere in the world

Growth Potential



 At Brida we highly value growth and development in all areas. With great performance, the potential for you as an
 Support Agent is significant:

Senior Support Agent role with ownership over complex escalations and help documentation

Customer Support Team Lead role to lead and manage other agents

title: Video Editor for Landscaping, Hardscaping & Exterior Remodeling
description:
Video Editor for Landscaping, Hardscaping & Exterior Remodeling



Skyline Exteriors Outdoor Living is hiring a full-time remote Video Editor based in the Philippines to edit video content from premium landscaping, hardscaping, outdoor living, and exterior remodeling projects.



We create high-end outdoor spaces for residential clients, commercial properties, HOAs, and other property owners throughout the Chicago area. We need an editor who can turn raw project footage into polished, story-driven videos that make the quality of our work obvious.



This is not a basic clip-cutting position. You will be responsible for helping Skyline present its projects professionally across social media, paid advertising, website content, sales materials, and client-facing presentations.





Schedule and Compensation

•Starting rate: $900 per month

•Shift: 8:00 PM–5:00 AM Philippine Time

•Chicago equivalent: 7:00 AM–4:00 PM Chicago time

•Lunch: 1-hour lunch break

•Paid working time: 8 hours per shift

•Schedule: Monday–Friday

•Location: Remote, Philippines

•Employment: Full-time, long-term





What You Will Edit

You will edit content from projects involving:

•Landscape design and installation

•Patios and walkways

•Paver installations

•Retaining walls

•Outdoor kitchens and living spaces

•Pergolas and decks

•Exterior remodeling

•Landscape lighting

•Plant installations

•Demolition and project transformations

•Before-and-after property upgrades

Responsibilities

•Turn raw footage, phone videos, drone footage, photos, and project updates into finished videos.

•Create short-form videos for Instagram Reels,
, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.

•Edit longer project walkthroughs, client presentations, and website videos.

•Build strong before-and-after edits that clearly show the transformation.

•Select music, sound effects, transitions, captions, and visual pacing appropriate for premium home-improvement content.

•Add branded titles, logos, captions, calls to action, and project details.

•Organize footage and project files so edits can be reviewed and reused.

•Follow Skyline’s brand style and maintain a polished, professional look.

•Create multiple versions of strong footage for different platforms and placements.

•Make revisions quickly and accurately based on feedback.

•Identify the strongest moments in raw footage instead of simply editing clips in chronological order.

•Coordinate with the U.S. team during the assigned shift.

•Meet deadlines and communicate immediately when a project is blocked or missing footage.





What Makes a Strong Edit at Skyline

A strong Skyline video should:

1.Capture attention in the first few seconds.

2.Make the project transformation immediately understandable.

3.Show craftsmanship, detail, scale, and finish quality.

4.Use clean pacing without unnecessary effects.

5.Make the property look premium and desirable.

6.Communicate the client’s problem, the transformation, and the final result.

7.Include a clear brand or sales objective when requested.

8.Be formatted correctly for the platform where it will be published.





Required Qualifications

•Demonstrated professional video-editing experience.

•Strong portfolio showing short-form and long-form edits.

•Experience editing home-improvement, construction, architecture, landscaping, remodeling, real estate, or similar visual project content is strongly preferred.

•Strong understanding of pacing, storytelling, hooks, captions, music, and visual hierarchy.

•Ability to create clean vertical videos for social media.

•Ability to take direction and make revisions without becoming defensive.

•Strong written English communication.

•Reliable internet connection and computer capable of editing high-resolution video.

•Ability to work the required overnight Philippines schedule consistently.

•Strong file organization and deadline discipline.





Preferred Skills

•Adobe Premiere Pro

•After Effects

•DaVinci Resolve

•CapCut Desktop

•Photoshop or Canva for thumbnails and visual assets

•Basic color correction and audio cleanup

•Motion graphics and branded text animation

•Drone footage editing

•Social-media content strategy

•Performance-based editing for ads





You do not need to use every program listed. We care more about the quality of your work, speed, reliability, and ability to follow a repeatable production system.





Ideal Candidate

You are a strong fit if you:

•Notice the details that make construction and landscape work look premium.

•Understand that editing is about attention, emotion, proof, and conversion—not just effects.

•Can take unorganized footage and find the story inside it.

•Work quickly without making the final product look rushed.

•Can follow a brand system consistently.

•Communicate clearly with a U.S.-based team.

•Meet deadlines without being chased.

•Want a long-term role with increasing responsibility.

You are not a fit if you:

•Submit template-based edits without understanding the footage.

•Miss deadlines repeatedly.

•Need constant follow-up to complete assigned work.

•Ignore brand instructions or revision notes.

•Cannot work the required schedule.

•Have no portfolio or relevant work samples.





Performance Standards

Your performance will be evaluated using:

•On-time project completion

•Quality of finished edits

•First-pass approval rate

•Revision volume and accuracy

•Output consistency

•File organization

•Communication speed

•Ability to follow the Skyline brand system

•Ability to create content that is usable for marketing and sales

What Skyline Offers

•Starting monthly rate of $900.

•Stable full-time schedule.

•Long-term opportunity with a growing U.S. company.

•Exposure to premium landscaping, hardscaping, and exterior remodeling projects.

•Clear workflows, deadlines, and feedback standards.

•Opportunity to take ownership of Skyline’s video-content system.

•Opportunity to grow into a senior editor or content-production lead.





How to Apply

To apply, send all of the following:

1.Your updated resume or work history.

2.A portfolio link with at least 5 relevant video edits.

3.Two examples of before-and-after, construction, landscaping, remodeling, real estate, or home-improvement edits if available.

4.The editing software you use.

5.Your computer specifications.

6.Your internet speed and backup internet plan.

7.Confirmation that you can work 8:00 PM–5:00 AM Philippine Time.

8.Your earliest available start date.

9.Your expected monthly rate, if different from the stated $900 starting rate.

10.A short answer to this question:

What makes a landscaping or remodeling project video look premium instead of ordinary?

Applications that do not include a portfolio will not be considered.

title: Online English/World History Teachers (Near-Native Accent)
description:
About Pomelo Academy

Pomelo Academy is an innovative online international school dedicated to delivering high-quality education to students worldwide. We provide a dynamic and engaging learning environment, catering to individualized instruction that transcends geographical boundaries.



Job Description

We are seeking passionate and experienced Near-Native English-speaking Online K-12 Math and/or Science Teachers with verifiable teaching certifications. The ideal candidates will have strong academic backgrounds in Mathematics and/or Science, experience teaching young learners (ages 5–18), and a commitment to creating a supportive, inquiry-based, and engaging online learning environment.



Responsibilities



Deliver interactive and engaging Math and/or Science lessons to individuals and small groups of 2–6 students aged 5–18.

Teach using internationally recognized curricula such as A Closer Look, Glencoe Science, Pearson Interactive Science, NGSS-aligned resources, Singapore Math, or IB/AP/A Level Math programs.

Create age-appropriate lesson plans focused on conceptual understanding, inquiry, problem-solving, and real-world applications.

Incorporate visuals, multimedia, and hands-on virtual activities to make abstract concepts accessible and engaging.

Monitor student progress and provide timely feedback to students and parents.

Foster curiosity, discussion, and active learning in a safe and supportive space.



Qualifications



Professional teacher with at least 2 years of teaching experience (Kindergarten–Grade 12).

Must hold a valid teaching license/certification (e.g., Teaching License, State Certification). TESOL/TEFL is a plus.

Near-native English accent with excellent spoken and written communication skills.

Strong academic background in Mathematics and/or Science (Biology, Physics, Chemistry, General Science).

Experience teaching in public/international schools or reputable online platforms.

Familiarity with inquiry-based and/or interdisciplinary approaches (e.g., STEM/STEAM).

Comfortable working between 07:00–22:00 (Weekdays) and 9:00–22:00 (Weekends), GMT+8.

Proficiency with digital platforms such as ClassIn, Microsoft Office, and other educational technologies.

Must have a stable and fast internet connection and a PC/laptop with at least Windows 10 or Mac OS Catalina.



Benefits



Flexible working hours.

Opportunity to teach using globally respected Math and Science curricula.

Be part of an international, passionate team of educators.

Access to training and professional development.

Regular enrollment model (not a booking system), ensuring schedule stability and consistency

title: QBO Staff Accountant for Accounting Firm (Incredible Benefits with Long-Term Growth)
description:
We are a full-service bookkeeping, accounting, tax, and CFO advisory services firm that is operated almost exclusively by our amazing team in the Philippines. Our focus is on optimizing how our clients use QuickBooks Online (QBO) so we can provide them with financial analytics and dashboards on a recurring basis to help their businesses thrive. Our firm is experiencing much more demand than we can handle, so we need to hire more bookkeepers to manage the onboarding, QBO cleanup, and daily bookkeeping needs of our clients.



Company Culture and Benefits:



We are a vibrant and supportive company. When you speak with our staff in the Philippines, you’ll find that we treat our team with respect and genuinely care for each member. Unlike many other firms, we recognize and value our international team members as client-facing experts. Your insights and contributions are not only welcomed but are essential to our growth and success.



We want someone who is fun to work with, has a positive attitude, is caring and kind to others in our team, is highly self-directed, highly organized, and has a very high standard for themselves. We also want someone who is willing to receive feedback and looking to continually improve so they can be a part of our team in 5 years, 10 years and even longer term.

What sets Simple Financials apart is our commitment to our team’s well-being and professional development. You are more important than the client; if a client disrespects you, we will prioritize your well-being over their business. Our culture is built on mutual respect, flexibility, and a genuine interest in helping each team member achieve their personal and professional goals. We listen to your feedback and work together to create a supportive and enriching work environment.



• Flexible Work Schedule: During your first three months of Onboarding and Training, it is suggested you come in during CST work hours to maximize your exposure to our company culture and get the training you need to perform at and above expectations. After successfully completing your Onboarding and Training phase, other than the team and client meetings scheduled in CST, you're free to work during your preferred hours.



• Health Insurance Reimbursement: We will reimburse part of your monthly PhilHealth and Social Security System payments for $30 monthly.



• Paid Time Off (PTO): You will start earning vacation leave credits the day you start working at Simple Financials. These leave credits accrue with worked hours, and by working 40 hours per week for the entire year, you will earn:

- 15 days of vacation leave credits per year for the first two years

- 18 days of vacation leave credits per year during your years 3 and 4

- 21 days of vacation leave credits per year after 5 years of tenure

- Unused vacation leaves will be paid out as cash the following year. The actual payout date will be announced separately.



• Paid Holidays: Simple Financials observes specific US holidays. On these days, you will get holiday pay equal to your regular number of hours per day:

• Independence Day (July 4),

• Thanksgiving Day (every 4th Thursday in November),

• Christmas Eve (December 24),

• Christmas Day (December 25),

• New Year’s Day (January 01), and

• New Year’s Eve (December 31)

• Easter Monday (Monday after Easter Sunday)



• Profit Sharing Program: Recently, we have introduced a profit-sharing program for all eligible staff members once they have completed the training and onboarding period. Candidates may also be eligible for profit sharing after 1 year of working with us.



• Company Retreats: To foster employee engagement, we organize in-person retreats or outings that also strengthen camaraderie among our team members. These usally occur two to three times per year.



• Ad Hoc Bonuses: Periodically, we give bonuses for personal milestones such as Mother’s Day, Birthday, Christmas, etc.



• Advancement, Growth, and Leadership: As we acquire more companies, you will have long-term growth potential for advanced roles and learning. Over the next 3-5 years, the successful applicant would progress in their role with more strategically-focused responsibilities and potentially manage a team of bookkeepers at higher compensation ranging from $30,000 USD (1.7M Philippine pesos) to $40,000 USD (2.25M Philippine pesos) annually.



The Ideal Candidate Will Have the Following Experience in QBO:

• At least one (1) year of working experience using QBO

• Assist in reviewing a client's QBO bookkeeping to identify issues and inaccuracies.

• Creating Journal Entries, monthly, quarterly, and annually for items such as payroll, depreciation, and amortization.

• Categorizing and matching transactions daily and weekly in the banking section.

• Creating invoices, sales receipts, credit memos, expenses, purchase orders, and bills in QBO.

• Accurately using Locations, Classes, and Tags in QBO for better reporting.

• Monthly reconciliations to ensure accuracy.

• Knowledge of advanced reporting features.



Other Requirements:

• Great written and spoken English.

• Timely and professional
 etiquette.

• Professional camera & microphone.

• A quiet space to have confidential and professional conversations with clients.



Compensation



The position will include a three-month training and onboarding period which will be compensated at $6 per hour for the first three months. After this period, compensation can increase to $7 to $8 per hour for the next nine months of working under the current management to advance in their role (more time if needed).

After a year of working with our company, compensation will increase to $8 to $10 per hour, with annual promotions and raises to follow, and can be higher given your level of success in the position.

description:

We're an established U.S. real estate brokerage looking for an exceptionally creative, tech savvy marketing professional to take our digital presence to the next level.

We're not looking for someone who simply creates Canva graphics and schedules social media posts. We want someone who understands what captures attention, knows how to grow an audience, embraces the latest AI technology, and can turn ordinary information into content people actually want to see.

Social Media Growth: Develop strategies to organically increase followers, engagement, brand awareness, and lead generation across
, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, and other platforms.

AI & Emerging Technology: Utilize advanced AI tools for content creation, video production, research, marketing automation, and innovative campaigns. Stay ahead of emerging technologies and introduce new ideas.

Creative Content & Storytelling: Write compelling captions, articles, video scripts, and marketing content that captures attention and encourages engagement.

Research & Data Analysis: Identify trends, research housing market statistics, and transform complex information into interesting graphics, videos, and stories that people want to share.

Graphic Design & Video Production: Create professional, visually impressive content using Canva, CapCut, AI video tools, and other creative platforms.

Marketing Strategy: Develop campaigns, analyze performance, identify growth opportunities, and proactively introduce fresh ideas.

REQUIRED SKILLS

• Strong understanding of social media platforms, algorithms, and audience growth strategies.

• Advanced knowledge of AI tools and creative marketing techniques.

• Exceptional English writing, storytelling, and communication skills.

• Strong graphic design and video editing abilities.

• Ability to research information and turn data into engaging content.

• Creative, resourceful, self motivated, and capable of working independently.

• Understanding of U.S. audiences, trends, and digital marketing.

• Ability to demonstrate your creativity and marketing capabilities through previous work.

• Exceptional reliability, honesty, accountability, and time management.

ADDITIONAL SKILLS WE'D LOVE TO SEE

• WordPress website design, development, and maintenance.

• SEO focused blog writing and content marketing.

• Experience with Kadence, Google Analytics, and Google Search Console.

• AI search optimization and emerging search technologies.

• Website landing pages and lead generation.

• Real estate marketing experience.

• Experience with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, Runway, and other advanced AI platforms.

• Knowledge of paid advertising, including
 and Google Ads.

Have other skills that could benefit our business? We'd love to hear about them! We're always interested in talented individuals who bring something new to the table.

HONESTY, RELIABILITY & ACCOUNTABILITY ARE NONNEGOTIABLE

We value integrity, dependability, and open communication just as much as talent.

We expect our team members to consistently fulfill their commitments, meet deadlines, communicate proactively, and take ownership of their work.

We understand that unexpected situations happen. What matters is being honest and communicating rather than disappearing, making excuses, or leaving the team wondering what's going on.

We have zero tolerance for dishonesty, falsified work hours, misrepresentation of skills, or repeated attendance and communication issues.

We treat our employees with respect and expect the same commitment in return.

If you're talented, honest, dependable, and passionate about your work, we'd love to meet you. If you cannot consistently honor your commitments, this position is not for you.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Someone who thinks beyond traditional marketing, constantly explores new technology, and understands how to make content stand out.

We want someone who can take an ordinary topic and turn it into something interesting, entertaining, educational, or even viral.

You don't need decades of experience. You need creativity, initiative, dependability, and the ability to deliver results.

POSITION DETAILS

Employment: Part Time to Start

Hours: 20 Hours Per Week

Compensation: Based on skills, experience, and demonstrated abilities.

Growth Opportunity: This position has the potential to become full time based on performance, measurable results, and the ability to help us achieve our marketing goals.

HOW TO APPLY

We're looking for exceptional talent, so please provide the following:

1. Resume

Tell us about your experience, skills, and background.

2. Portfolio

Show us your best work! Include examples of social media content, graphics, videos, marketing campaigns, websites, or anything else that demonstrates your creativity.

If you've successfully grown social media accounts, we'd love to see the results.

3. Short Introduction Video

Submit a 60 to 90 second video introducing yourself, highlighting your marketing strengths, and explaining why you'd be a great fit for this position.

4. AI Experience

Tell us which AI tools you use regularly and share an example of something impressive you've created using AI.

5. Additional Skills

What other skills, technologies, or creative abilities do you have that could bring value to our brokerage?

CREATIVE THINKING QUESTION

Our real estate brokerage serves Northern Arizona, including Prescott, Prescott Valley, and surrounding communities. We specialize in residential home sales, vacant land, foreclosures (REO), and short sales. We work with traditional buyers and sellers, investors, and homeowners facing financial challenges.

Imagine you're given housing market data showing that home prices in Northern Arizona have dropped 8% over the past year.

How would you turn this information into engaging social media content that attracts attention, sparks conversations, increases our following, and potentially generates new business?

Consider our different audiences and areas of expertise when developing your ideas.

We don't want a generic marketing response. We want to see your creativity, strategic thinking, and ability to turn market information into content people actually want to read, watch, and share.

Bonus points if you can show us something innovative using AI!

NEXT STEPS

We will review your resume, portfolio, introduction video, and responses.

Candidates whose submissions demonstrate the creativity, skills, reliability, and potential we're looking for will receive a link to our official application page for the next step in our hiring process.

We're excited to find someone who brings fresh ideas, creative energy, and a passion for technology to our team!

title: Media Buyer
description:
Cellexia Labs currently serves customers in markets all over the world, with our fastest-growing communities in Europe, the US, Canada, and Australia. We're a fully remote, international team, small by design, where everyone owns something real and decisions are made by the people closest to the work.



In skincare, the ad is where the relationship starts. A stranger scrolling past on a phone gives us a second or two, and in that time the ad has to earn a look, a click, and the start of trust. Done well, it brings in customers who stay and reorder. Done badly, it burns budget on people who were never going to buy.



This role runs that moment. You'll own our Meta advertising: what we test, what we scale, where the budget goes, and how we know it's working. It's work where decisions turn into numbers within days, and every number tells you something.

For a sharp, driven media buyer who wants their work judged by results, this is a rare opportunity: ownership of a growing brand's biggest growth channel.



A few examples of your responsibilities



Own the Meta ad account. Plan, launch, and manage campaigns across our markets. You'll d
 the structure, the audiences, the budgets, and when to scale or cut.



Build a testing engine. Run a steady stream of tests on creative, hooks, angles, audiences, and offers. Know what you're testing, why, and what you'll do with the result.



Scale what works. Find the winners, push spend up without breaking performance, and keep acquisition profitable as budgets grow.



Work hand in hand with the creative team. Turn what the data shows into clear briefs for our writers and video editors, so the next round of ads is sharper than the last.



Make the numbers trustworthy. Keep tracking and attribution clean, so every decision rests on data you can believe. Report on cost per acquisition, return on ad spend, and customer quality.



Take every market seriously. Adapt campaigns to the tastes, budgets, and buying habits of customers in Europe, the US, Canada, Australia, and beyond.



Keep the account healthy. Know Meta's ad policies, especially for skincare claims, and keep our campaigns compliant and our account in good standing.



Move fast without cutting corners. Use AI tools to speed up analysis, research, and reporting, then apply your own judgment to make the final calls.



What we look for



Analytical mind. You read the numbers and know what they mean. You can tell a real signal from noise, and explain why a campaign is working or not.



Hands-on skill. You've managed Meta ad accounts with real budgets and understand how structure, creative, and audience work together.



Creative instinct. You can tell a strong ad from a weak one before the data does, and you can explain why in words a writer or editor can use.



Ownership. You treat every campaign as yours until it performs. You hold yourself to a bar that keeps rising.



Calm under pressure. You stay steady when performance dips, find the cause, and act without panicking or hiding the problem.



Team spirit. You support the best idea, not your own. You take feedback well and give it generously.



Relevant experience. [2+] years running Meta ads for e-commerce or consumer brands, with results you can show, ideally with the numbers to prove it. Experience in beauty, skincare, or another consumer category is a strong advantage. Excellent written English is essential.



What we offer



Fast decisions, minimal bureaucracy. Your ideas are taken seriously here, whatever your title or tenure, and the best ones get tested.



Competitive pay, set for where you live. We pay well above local market norms.



Yearly bonuses of up to 40% of your annual salary. When the brand grows, you share in it.



Monthly and yearly subsidies to do your best work. Every month, we put money toward the things that make you more productive: wellness, focus, hardware and internet upgrades, and more. You know what you need better than we do, so you d
 how to use it.



Impact you can see. Campaigns go live fast here, and results come back quickly. You'll watch your decisions move the numbers.



A small team that moves fast. Good ideas get tested quickly.



Work from anywhere. Fully remote, with an international team and the flexibility that comes with it.



A path that grows with the company. As Cellexia Labs scales, the buyer who runs our growth channel is the buyer best placed to lead it.



The selection process



We care about what you can do, not how polished your CV looks. That's why our process is built around how you think and work, not just where you've worked.



Step 1: Apply. Submit your application and CV through this link: 

Step 2: Online assessments. Right after you apply, you'll take two short tests: a problem-solving test and a personality test. The problem-solving test shows us how you reason through unfamiliar challenges. The personality test helps us understand how you work and whether the way we operate will suit you.

Step 3: Interview. If your results stand out, we'll invite you to interview with the team.



We move quickly. The whole process, from application to interview invitation, takes a couple of days.



If you like the role and believe you could excel at it, don't talk yourself out of applying. A less conventional background is welcome here if your results speak for themselves.



Before you apply



Cellexia Labs is a demanding environment. We hold ourselves to a high bar, and we ask the same of the people who join us. In return, you get real freedom, work that goes live, and a front-row seat to the growth of a brand.



If this sounds like the work you want to be doing, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply here:

Key Responsibilities



Prepare and post journal entries, accruals and adjusting entries.

Strong Microsoft Excel skills and attention to detail.



Strong written and spoken English communication skills.



Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines and work independently with minimal supervision.

Experience supporting multiple U.S. business entities or companies across different industries.



Experience with intercompany accounting, consolidations and multi-entity financial reporting.

Familiarity with AI tools, accounting automation and process improvements.



Experience working directly with U.S.-based accounting or finance leadership.

Compensation & Engagement

This is an independent contractor opportunity without employee benefits. Payments are made monthly on net-30 terms through an approved payment method.



We are interested in developing an ongoing contractor relationship, with an initial engagement of up to one year and potential renewal based on business needs, performance and overall fit.



How to Apply



Please
 
 with the subject:



Remote Accountant Application

A brief overview of your relevant accounting experience.



The U.S.-based companies or clients you have supported and the approximate dates of those engagements.



Your proposed monthly contractor bid in USD, based on the expected workload of 50-60 hours per week.



Your availability to work within U.S. Eastern Time business hours and your earliest possible start date.



Important Application Requirements



Your resume must clearly demonstrate:

Relevant experience with general ledger accounting, financial reporting and monthly or quarterly close.



Substantive accounting responsibilities beyond basic bookkeeping, AP/AR processing or external audit.

title: Recruitment and Sales Manager - Australian hours
description:
3 months to start at 40 hours per week, with genuine room to continue on and even be promoted | Contractor | Work from home | Immediate start

Real Deal Entertainment (Australia)



IMPORTANT: Applications will only be considered if they include a CV, a video introduction, and written responses to the questions set out below.



THE HONEST SHAPE OF THIS JOB



Two things sit in this seat from day one, and the balance between them shifts as the season moves. We would rather set that out now than have you discover it in week three.



The urgent job is recruiting Christmas Entertainers! For roughly the next month you would be advertising, screening and interviewing performers - Santas, Mrs Clauses, elves, facepainters and photographers - and getting them checked, signed and ready for the season.



After that the hiring eases, but the performer side does not stop. Onboarding, scheduling, logistics, and being the person a performer rings when something goes wrong on the morning of a job.



Alongside all of that, every day, you would be working the sales side: following up the quotes we have already sent and turning them into bookings. From January, when the performer work quietens down, sales becomes the bulk of the role.



ABOUT US



Real Deal Entertainment runs three brands in Australia: The Real Santa, Halloween Scenes and Happy Easter Bunny. We supply professional performers - Santa, Mrs Claus, elves, the Easter Bunny - and large event props, thrones, grottos and sets, to corporate clients, shopping centres, councils, hospitality venues, schools and childcare centres.



It is a premium product at a premium price, and it is seasonal. September to December is our peak, and that is when you would start.



HOW THE WORK ACTUALLY SITS



Month one, mostly recruiting. Writing and placing the advertisements, screening applicants, interviewing, and the Working with Children compliance that goes with putting people in front of children. This is the urgent part, and it is why we are hiring straight away.



We will say plainly that this part is good fun. You would spend a fair bit of your day talking to actors, entertainers and genuinely white-bearded gentlemen, and d
 which of them is good enough to be somebody's Santa. The people who do well at it are the people who enjoy it.



Through the season, running the roster. Onboarding the people you hired, scheduling them against bookings, sorting out the logistics, and keeping them supported. Performers need moral support as much as they need instructions, and the ones who feel looked after are the ones who turn up and do a good job.



Every day, the sales tasks. Time on the open quote bank: ringing clients who already have a quote from us and turning it into a booking. This part does not wait until January.



January onward, mostly sales. Recruiting drops to almost nothing until Easter, so your hours move across: warm calls to past clients who have not rebooked, then reaching out to new ones.



The roster you build is not thrown away. The same performers work our Halloween and Easter seasons, so you would be building something that carries across the year.



THE HOURS



40 hours per week, worked from home. Monday to Friday, 9:00am to 6:00pm Melbourne time, with a one-hour break. If you are applying from the Philippines, that is 6:00am to 3:00pm your time, or 7:00am to 4:00pm once Daylight Saving finishes - the same window the rest of our team works. An early start, but an early finish.



The window is fixed rather than left to you, and it is worth saying why. Client calls only work when Australian clients pick up the phone, and our own call records say that is the afternoon, Melbourne time. The performer side of the job fills the earlier part of the day.



PAY



US$1,330 per month (paid as AU$440 per week), invoiced by you as an independent contractor.



Christmas Day and New Year's Day are not worked, and your fee for those weeks is unchanged.



If the role continues past the first three months, the sales side of it carries commission on top of the weekly fee, on the business you bring in. We would rather agree those rates with you when we know what the role has become than put a number in an advertisement and change it later.



BEFORE YOU APPLY



Note this is a full time role and it will require your complete commitment for the three months. So if you have a side hustle, a part time job, or a house full of kids, we really don't think this will work. We want to put that out there now so there is no disappointment later.



You will need to learn and study fast, meet pressing deadlines, and solve problems daily.



WHAT YOU WOULD ACTUALLY DO



Performers:

- Write and place the advertisements that bring performers in, and keep running the ones that work.

- Screen applicants properly - read the applications, watch the videos, and shortlist on evidence.

- Run the initial interviews - often just a quick phone call - and put a shortlist in front of the Managing Director with your recommendation on each person. You are the first person a performer meets, so how you handle them matters.

- Look after the compliance side: Working with Children Checks and the state-by-state requirements that go with them.

- Onboard the people you hire - paperwork, costumes, briefing, and making sure they know exactly what is expected of them on the day.

- Book the final interviews in, and schedule performers against bookings once they are cast - with all the logistics that go with it.

- Be the person they ring when something goes wrong on the morning of a job, and keep good people feeling looked after.

- Keep the performer records accurate - availability, documents, contact details, and your notes on how people went.



Sales:

- Work the open quote bank to a clear outcome - booked, lost, or closed with a reason.

- Have a proper conversation on every live quote rather than a quick check-in. Find out what the client is actually trying to do with their event.

- Offer the upgrade where it genuinely fits, and leave it alone where it does not.

- Warm calls to clients who have not rebooked, and outreach to new ones, from lists we supply and leads you find.

- Write a dated note in our CRM after every conversation: what the client wants, what you offered, and the next step.



Throughout:

- Short, clear written updates to the Managing Director. Not long reports.

- Use AI to do all of this faster and better, and tell us how you are doing it.



WHAT SITS WITH SOMEONE ELSE



- Raising quotes and invoices. Our customer service team does that; you request and check.

- New inbound sales enquiries. They go to our customer service team.

- The final interview, and the decision on who gets the part. That sits with the Managing Director.



You will still take inbound calls - from performers, and from clients ringing you back after you have called them.



WHERE THIS CAN GO



We cannot promise a permanent role on day one, and we would rather not pretend otherwise.



What we can tell you is that the work does not stop. Easter recruiting begins in the new year, then Winter Christmas, then Halloween, and the sales side runs all year round. We would far rather grow the person already doing it than advertise again.



At the end of the three months we will sit down and talk openly about continuing, about what the role becomes, and about what it pays. If the answer is no, we will tell you why.



WHO WE ARE HOPING TO HEAR FROM



- Someone who has genuinely done both - hired people and sold to people - and can point to each. If your experience sits almost entirely on one side, this is probably not the right fit, though do tell us if you think we have that wrong.

- Someone who would enjoy the performer side rather than tolerate it. Half this job is making good people want to work for you.

- Someone with excellent spoken and written English. You would be interviewing performers and talking to Australian clients.

- Someone confident enough to make a judgement about a person and explain it.

- Someone who uses AI daily and can talk about it in detail - which tools, for what, and what it has actually saved them.

- Someone careful with records and deadlines, who would rather check than assume.

- Performance or event operations experience is a bonus, not a requirement.



WHAT YOU WOULD NEED



- A quiet, professional space for interviews and client calls, a good headset, and reliable internet and power with a backup plan.

- Confident, clear spoken English that an Australian client follows easily. This is the first thing we listen for.

- To invoice us as an independent contractor and look after your own tax and statutory contributions.



HOW TO APPLY



Three parts, about twenty minutes. We read every application that includes all three, and we do not read the ones that do not.



1. Your CV.



2. A video introduction, about two minutes, answering both of the questions below in a single unedited take. Please do not script it - we would rather hear you think than hear you read.



   a. A performer you recruited has cancelled on the morning of a client's event. Talk us through your first ten minutes.



   b. A client has a quote for $1,200 and says that is more than they budgeted. Talk us through how you would respond, as if you were on the call.



3. In writing, no more than 300 words: tell us about one person you hired who worked out well, and one sale you nearly lost and then won. What did you do in each? Finish with one line on which AI tool you use most, and what for.



If you are shortlisted, we will do a short exercise together: we give you our full price list to read for twenty minutes, then ask you ten questions on it with the document closed, and finish with a mock follow-up call. It is all done live in the one session - there is nothing to take away and complete.

* Carrier portals

* Application status

* Underwriting requirements

* Policy issue and placement

* Policy packets

* Beneficiary and ownership information

* Bank drafts and payment information

* Client documentation

* Policy conservation and lapse prevention



**Experience in other industries does not substitute for life insurance experience.**



General VA, real estate, healthcare, customer service, appointment setting, or administrative experience alone will **not** qualify you for this position.



## Responsibilities



Your primary responsibility will be helping life insurance brokers manage their post-sale administrative workload.



Typical tasks include:



* Checking carrier portals for application and policy updates

* Reviewing and completing **pending requirements**

* Following up with clients for missing documents, signatures, banking information, identification, or other requirements

* Following up with carriers regarding outstanding cases

* Tracking applications from submission through issue and placement

* Sending and following up on **policy packets**

* Confirming clients have received required policy documents

* Assisting with policy delivery requirements

* Monitoring policies that may be at risk of lapsing or cancelling

* Assisting with policy conservation and administrative follow-up

* Updating case notes and client records

* Maintaining accurate task and policy statuses

* Suppressing leads after applications or sales when required

* Updating CRM records and client information

* Organizing documents and maintaining accurate case files

* Communicating clearly with brokers regarding outstanding requirements and case updates

* Completing other life-insurance-related back-office administrative tasks



## What We Expect



We are looking for someone who understands that outstanding requirements can directly impact whether a life insurance policy gets issued and placed.



You must be:



* Highly organized

* Detail-oriented

* Comfortable managing multiple insurance cases at once

* Proactive about following up on outstanding requirements

* Able to identify cases that require urgent attention

* Comfortable navigating multiple carrier websites and portals

* Able to communicate professionally with clients, brokers, and carriers

* Consistent with documenting your work

* Comfortable following established SOPs and workflows

* Responsible when handling confidential client information



You should not need to be taught the basics of how a life insurance application moves through underwriting.



## Qualifications



**Required:**



* Previous professional experience in the **U.S. life insurance industry**

* Experience working with life insurance applications and pending requirements

* Experience using life insurance carrier portals

* Understanding of the application → underwriting → issue → placement process

* Strong written and spoken English

* Strong attention to detail

* Reliable computer and internet connection

* Ability to follow standardized procedures and maintain accurate records



Experience with tools such as **GoHighLevel (GHL), CRMs, electronic signature platforms, password managers, and task-management systems** is helpful, but life insurance experience is the primary requirement.



## Important



This is **not a cold-calling or insurance sales position**.



Beacon Administrative VAs focus primarily on **post-sale operations and administrative support** so that licensed brokers can focus on selling and advising their clients.



### To Apply

1. How many years of life insurance experience you have.

2. What company, agency, IMO/FMO, or insurance organization you worked with.

3. Your specific responsibilities in that role.

4. Which life insurance carriers you have experience working with.

**Applications without previous life insurance experience will not be considered.**

Miss K Kitchen & Bath Remodels is a growing residential remodeling company serving Salt Lake City and Utah County, USA.



We specialize in kitchen, bathroom, and whole-home renovations, delivering exceptional craftsmanship and a highly personalized remodeling experience.

* Project Scheduling: Build and manage construction schedules, coordinate subcontractors, and proactively resolve scheduling conflicts.

* Budget Management: Track project expenses, monitor budgets, forecast costs, and identify potential overruns.

* Subcontractor Coordination: Communicate regularly with US-based subcontractors by telephone to coordinate schedules and resolve issues.

* Client Invoicing: Prepare project invoices and track upcoming payment milestones.

* Project Reporting: Provide weekly reports on project progress, schedules, budgets, and potential risks.

* Team Collaboration: Work closely with our Utah-based Site Superintendent and remote Client Success Manager to keep projects running efficiently.



This is a behind-the-scenes operations role with no direct homeowner engagement or sales responsibilities.



What We’re Looking For



* Minimum 3 years of construction estimating or project management experience.

* Strong understanding of US residential construction, particularly kitchen and bathroom remodeling.

* Experience preparing detailed scopes of work and construction estimates.

* Ability to read construction drawings and understand trade sequencing.

* Experience managing construction budgets and schedules.

* Excellent spoken and written English.

* Confidence making frequent telephone calls to American subcontractors.

* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and problem-solving abilities.

* Experience with Houzz Pro, Buildertrend, CoConstruct, or similar construction management software.

* Reliable internet and ability to work overnight Philippines hours to align with Utah business hours.



Houzz Pro experience is highly preferred.



Performance Bonuses



In addition to regular compensation, we offer performance bonuses for successfully completed projects:



* $50 USD when a project meets its approved schedule target (within seven calendar days).

* $75 USD when a project finishes within 3% of its approved budget.



Earn up to $125 USD per qualifying project.



Bonuses are evaluated after project completion and financial closeout, subject to company performance standards.



How to Apply

3. An example of a construction scope of work or estimate you’ve prepared, with confidential information removed.

Attorney | Lawyer | Juris Doctor (JD) | Legal Counsel | Corporate Counsel | HR & Recruiting Manager | Full-Time | Potential Long Term Opportunity 



Juris Doctor (JD), Bachelor of Laws (LL.B.), Attorneys, Lawyers, and Legal Professionals are encouraged to apply. Bar admission is preferred but not required.



We are seeking a highly organized legal professional to serve as our In-House Legal Counsel, HR Manager, and Recruiting Manager. This leadership role combines corporate legal support with human resources, recruiting, onboarding, compliance, and executive advisory responsibilities.



You will serve as the company's primary legal resource, working directly with executive leadership to review contracts, negotiate business agreements, ensure legal compliance, develop company policies, and provide legal guidance for business operations. You will also oversee recruiting, employee onboarding, and HR processes to help build and support a high-performing organization.



This is an excellent opportunity for a JD, LL.B. graduate, Attorney, Lawyer, or Legal Counsel looking to combine legal expertise with business leadership in a growing company.



Responsibilities



Legal Counsel & Corporate Compliance



* Serve as the company's primary legal advisor for day-to-day business operations

* Provide legal guidance and strategic support to executive leadership

* Draft, review, revise, and negotiate contracts, vendor agreements, client agreements, employment agreements, NDAs, service agreements, and other legal documents

* Negotiate contract terms with vendors, clients, partners, and third parties

* Conduct legal research and provide practical business recommendations

* Ensure compliance with employment laws, corporate regulations, and company policies

* Develop, maintain, and update employee handbooks, company policies, compliance procedures, and internal documentation

* Identify legal and operational risks and recommend solutions to minimize exposure

* Assist executives with business-related legal matters, contract interpretation, compliance, and strategic decision-making

* Maintain strict confidentiality while handling sensitive legal and executive matters



Human Resources, Recruiting & Onboarding



* Lead the company's recruiting and talent acquisition efforts

* Source, screen, interview, and coordinate hiring for open positions

* Manage the full employee onboarding process from offer acceptance through orientation

* Maintain employee records and HR documentation

* Ensure HR processes comply with applicable laws and company policies

* Support employee relations, performance management, and HR best practices

* Partner with leadership to improve hiring, retention, and organizational development

* Continuously improve recruiting, onboarding, and HR processes



Qualifications



* Juris Doctor (JD) or Bachelor of Laws (LL.B.) required

* Admission to the Philippine Bar is preferred but not required

* Experience in legal research, contract drafting, corporate law, employment law, or business law preferred

* Experience with HR, recruiting, onboarding, or talent acquisition is a strong plus

* Excellent contract drafting and negotiation skills

* Strong analytical, communication, and organizational abilities

* High level of integrity, professionalism, and discretion

* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment



Schedule



* Full-Time

* 40 hours per week

* Monday-Friday

* PST Business Hours



Compensation



*$5+ USD per hour, depending on qualifications and experience



What We Offer



* Executive leadership role with direct access to company ownership

* Meaningful work influencing legal strategy, compliance, recruiting, and HR operations

* Collaborative, supportive leadership team

* Opportunity to build and improve the company's legal and people operations



**Apply today by submitting your resume and a brief introduction highlighting your legal education, contract experience, HR or recruiting experience, and why you're interested in this opportunity.

title: Paid Media Buyer (Performance Marketing)
description:
Starting USD $1,000 - $1,400 / month | Full-time | Remote | Immediate start | Asia Time Zone



You own two of our four newer channels and grow them: TikTok, Snapchat, Reddit, Taboola.

This is for people who think in ROAS, spot what is working before anyone asks, and want to run a channel rather than upload to one.



Apply below:





---



[1] About Ally

Ally helps founders and leaders scale themselves before they scale their companies.

Founded by leaders who have scaled and operated 8-figure businesses, we partner with top operators and support clients including a NASDAQ-listed company.

We are not a traditional VA agency. We are a modern operating partner.

This role sits with one of our clients, a DTC brand that went from zero to around $100M USD in under three years and now runs paid spend across six platforms.

The brand sells sexual wellness products. The category is high risk for ad and account bans, which is why keeping your accounts alive is a real part of the job. If that is not for you, better to know now.



---



[2] The Role

You own two of four: TikTok, Snapchat, Reddit, Taboola. Which two is d
 when we assign them, and channels move around as the team grows, so you will not be on the same two forever.

We are hiring for this now and want someone starting as soon as they can.

Nobody here has run these at scale. There is no playbook, no baseline, and in some cases no target yet. You set them. What you write becomes what the team uses after you.

The work is end to end. Who the audience is on your channel, what angle lands with them, what landing page that angle needs, and what assets. What is already working on Meta you adapt. What does not exist on Meta but you think would work on yours, you propose and test.

You are also the only person who knows your channels. When an account gets restricted, and in this category it will, you are the one who diagnoses it, appeals it, and gets it back.

Leadership does not open the ad platforms. They read your report. So it has to be right every single day, and it has to come with a point of view, not just a set of figures.

From day one you own: which ads run on your channels, the daily report, your ad accounts including setting up a replacement when one gets rejected, and the advertorials.

For the first month or two, budgets, scaling and cutting go to the marketing lead first. After that they are yours, inside a ROAS floor with no budget cap while it holds.

You do not pick agencies or pay bills. Everything else on your channels is yours.

You assume the method, not the standard. Research it, build it paused, flag it, bring a recommendation. That is yours from day one and we want more of it. Setting a target or a bar, you propose with your reasoning. Anything that moves money or goes live, you ask, for the first month or two.



---



[3] What You'll Do

What you own:

How your two channels perform. The spend, the accounts, setting up a replacement when one gets rejected, flagging billing before a lapse stops a campaign, and the relationship with your platform reps.

The daily report on your channels. Build it and maintain it, and know why each formula works rather than just where to type the number.

Keeping your accounts alive. Watch policy changes, spot the risk early, and act before a channel gets disrupted. There is no one else covering this for you.

The playbook. Write down what works as you learn it, so the next person does not start where you did.

Spotting things first. Underperformance, anomalies and opportunities reach the team from you, not the other way round.



What a normal day looks like:

First thing: check nothing has stopped. Billing, account health, rejected ads or accounts, any policy notice. If something is about to break, you flag it before it does.

Then the report. Pull the numbers, build it, and say what happened, why, and what to do next. It goes out at a fixed time every morning and leadership d
 off it.

Then the work on your channels. New creative live, tests set up, budgets moved, the calls on what to scale and what to cut. Approved by the marketing lead at first, then yours.

All day: ask. Ten questions a day is fine. A quiet week is not.



Every week:

Review what ran and say what to make more of.

Bring back something another brand is doing on your channels that we should test.

Draft one advertorial with AI for approval.



---



[4] What Success Looks Like at 90 Days

Your channels are growing. Spend and revenue up, ROAS at or above target.

Your reports are trusted. Leadership d
 off them without checking the platforms, and they have been right every day.

Nothing has stopped. No campaign down from a billing lapse, a rejected account, or a policy change you did not see coming.

You have a repeatable way to test on your channels and you find winners every week, not occasionally.

There is a written playbook for your channels where there was none.



---



[5] What We're Looking For

You have run paid on at least one platform with real spend. Meta or Google is fine, that is where most people's depth sits. Not uploading. You know what to check, what to look at, and why. This is the one thing we cannot train from zero.

Hands-on time on TikTok, Snapchat, Reddit or Taboola. This is the rarest thing on this list and the one we most want. If you have run any of them with your own budget, say which and say what you learned.

You can run an account, not just a campaign. Setup, rejections, billing, replacements, platform reps. You are the only person who knows your channel, so when it breaks you fix it.

You can start from nothing. No SOP, no baseline, no benchmark. You work out what good looks like and write it down.

You read the sheet, you do not just fill it. You know why the formula works and you catch the wrong number before the reader does.

You ask questions constantly. We would rather you ask ten times a day than stay quiet and hand in a report with mistakes in it.

Initiative. You see what needs doing and you do it. We can tell within a week who has this and who does not.

You present data clearly. Accurate numbers, clean formatting, a report someone who never opens an ad platform can d
 from.

Meta and Google experience counts. You start on the newer channels, but assignments move around as the team grows, so depth on the big two is worth having and worth telling us about.

Useful, not required: bulk tooling like AdManage or Revealbot, advertorial writing, AI in your workflow, and generating a few assets yourself with AI rather than waiting on an agency.

On creative: our internal team and the agencies produce the main assets, and you tell them what the data says to make more of. For small iterations on your own channel you will not always want to wait for them, so being able to prompt an AI tool into a usable asset is handy. Ten assets, not a hundred. We are not asking you to edit anything by hand.



---



[6] Schedule

5 days a week, 8am to 5pm Philippine time. Your two days off include one weekday, so one of your five working days falls on a weekend and the team always has coverage. We confirm which days when we assign your channels.

A sixth day is overtime.



---



[7] What You'll Get

USD $1,000 - $1,400 a month to start, full time

Two weeks of one-to-one walkthrough with the marketing lead, then real decision rights once you have earned them

Two channels of your own on a brand that scaled to around $100M. A track record you can point at later, with the numbers to show for it

The playbook for your channels with your name on it

Paid subscriptions to the tools you need, and direct access to the operators you work with

Fully remote setup

Asia Time Zone



---



[8] HOW TO APPLY

Submit your application here:



You will be asked to:

Upload your CV or LinkedIn profile

Record a short video (2-3 mins) answering:



1. Which of TikTok, Snapchat, Reddit and Taboola have you personally run ads on, and which have you never touched? Be honest. Most people have none of them and we would rather know now.

2. Take your strongest platform that is not Meta. Name one thing that works differently there. Something you learned by running it, not by reading about it.

3. Your ad account gets restricted on a Tuesday morning. What do you do in the first hour?



We are listening for how you think, not how polished you are. No video, no shortlist.

Applications sent outside this link will not be reviewed.

title: Experienced Video Editor
description:
Long-Form YouTube Editor for Finance Education Channel (Documentary Style)



Type of employment:

Part Time



Job description:



About the channel



I run The Capital Vault, a US-based capital advisory that helps established business owners ($2M-$20M revenue) secure growth capital for buyouts, acquisitions, expansions, and debt restructures. I’m building a YouTube channel that explains how business financing actually works: why banks say no, how lenders read a P&L, how a $2M deal actually gets structured, and the parts of the money system nobody explains to business owners.



The audience is business owners, operators, and people who want to understand capital. The tone is an insider pulling back the curtain. Not hype, not “get rich,” not finance-bro content. Think of it as the finance channel that respects the viewer’s intelligence.



I’m looking for a long-form editor who can turn my raw talking-head recordings into polished, high-retention videos that match a specific visual style.



The video style (this is the important part)



Every video follows the same visual language. Before you apply, make sure this is a style you can execute and enjoy:



Documentary feel, not vlog feel. Think clean, cinematic, deliberate. Reference the pacing and polish of channels like Johnny Harris, Ali Abdaal’s long-form explainers, and the Hormozi-style business breakdowns. Confident cuts, no jump-cut chaos.

High contrast, dark and clean. Deep navy and black backgrounds, gold accents for emphasis. Minimal color palette. Everything looks expensive and intentional.

Numbers on screen, always. This is a finance channel, so every key figure ($2M deal, 60 days, 27-point approval gap) appears as bold on-screen text the moment I say it. Big, clean, sans-serif, animated in with subtle motion.

Charts and explainers that teach. When I explain a concept (DSCR, a capital stack, why a bank declined a file), you build a simple animated graphic that makes it click: bars rising, a flow diagram, a before-and-after comparison. Simple beats fancy. The graphic exists to make the idea land, not to show off.

Captions on everything. Clean, readable, styled to match the brand. Key phrases highlighted.

B-roll that’s relevant and original. Screen recordings, documents, my own footage, custom graphics. No generic stock footage of handshakes and skylines. If a visual doesn’t add meaning, it doesn’t go in.

Hooks that hold. The first 30 seconds are tight and visual: the claim, the number, the question, on screen fast. You understand retention curves and cut for them.

No gimmicks. No zoom-in-every-3-seconds, no meme sound effects, no over-edited energy. Calm authority. The edit should feel like the viewer is being let in on something.



If you can watch a 15-minute Johnny Harris or a Hormozi breakdown and explain why the edit holds attention, you’ll understand what I’m after.



What you’ll do



Edit 1-2 long-form videos per week (8-20 minutes final length) from raw talking-head footage I record, plus a script for each

Cut filler, tighten pacing, and structure the video so retention holds from the hook to the close

Build the on-screen text, number callouts, captions, and simple animated charts and explainers that illustrate financial concepts

Build clean intros, chapter cards, transitions, and end screens in the brand style

Source or create relevant B-roll (screen recordings, documents, graphics), never generic stock

Deliver a first cut within 48-72 hours, revisions within 24

Study my past videos and the reference channels I share, match the style, then improve on it over time

Flag anything in the footage that could be stronger (a better order, a cut that would hold attention better). I want an editor with opinions.



What I’m looking for



2+ years editing long-form YouTube content, with a portfolio of 8-20 minute videos you’ve personally cut

Strong storytelling and pacing instincts: you know how to hold attention for 15 minutes, not just 15 seconds

Clean motion graphics and text animation (simple, professional, consistent)

Comfortable turning numbers I give you into simple charts and visual explainers

Proficient in Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve (After Effects a plus)

Reliable, communicative, and able to work independently from a brief

Comfortable with finance and business content (no finance background required, but you take the material seriously and ask when you don’t understand a concept)

Bonus: thumbnail design, short-form clipping from long-form (Opus Clip, Vizard), or experience with educational/explainer channels



How we’ll work



Paid trial: you’ll edit one long-form video from footage and a script I provide, so we can both see if the fit is right

Clear brief and script for every video, feedback in writing, workflow in Slack

Payment every two weeks via bank transfer

Original B-roll and graphics only. No generic stock footage.

Consistent weekly volume. This is a steady role, not one-off gigs.



To apply, include



Links to 3-5 long-form YouTube videos you edited (8+ minutes). Educational, finance, business, or documentary-style content preferred.

One sentence on why the edit in your best sample holds attention

Your editing software

Your availability per week and your rate



Start your application with the words “CAPITAL VAULT” so I know you read the full post.



I’m looking for someone to grow with. If the trial goes well, this becomes a steady long-term role, with the option to expand into short-form clipping, thumbnails, and a larger content operation as the channel grows.



Wage/Salary:

$500-$900/month (part-time, based on experience and output), with growth to full-time





:





Business or Contact Name (public):

The Capital Vault



Skills (select up to 3):

Video Editing, Motion Graphics, YouTube Content Creation

Send a daily
