title: Sales & Estimator Executive
description:
Location: Remote (Australia-based hours)

Australian windows and doors manufacturing company.



A must:

- Previous experience in sales, sales coordination, estimating & quoting, customer service, administration, operations and marketing campaigns, or similar role.

- Ability to work Monday to Friday, 9:00am–5:30pm AEST. 30 minutes lunch time. 

- Reliable access to a computer or laptop (not Chromebook), mobile phone, headset, and fast, stable internet (with a backup plan in place)

- Provide full access to track computer screens and be comfortable being watched on camera during working hours.

- Quiet home working environment free from distractions (not suitable for candidates with young children at home)

- High Attention to details



About the Role



We are seeking a proactive, organised, and highly capable Sales & Operations Executive to take ownership of the day-to-day sales, customer communication, lead management, marketing coordination, and operational activities of our business.



This is a hands-on role within a small business, where the successful candidate will work independently and take responsibility for managing tasks from initial enquiry through to sales conversion and ongoing operational follow-up.



The role reports directly to management and requires someone who is confident working autonomously, managing multiple priorities, following up consistently, and ensuring that tasks are completed accurately and on time.



Sales & Customer Management:

Manage incoming sales enquiries and leads from initial contact through to conversion or final outcome.

Call new leads within 24 hours of receiving an enquiry.

Communicate with prospective and existing clients by phone, email, and other relevant channels.

Understand client requirements and obtain the necessary information to prepare accurate quotations.

Prepare and issue quotes and estimates to clients.

Proactively follow up on outstanding quotes and enquiries until a clear outcome is reached.

Maintain regular communication with clients throughout the sales process.

Identify opportunities to convert enquiries into sales and maximise sales opportunities.

Maintain a professional and positive customer experience throughout the sales process.

Meet the KPI's. Sales per week & month in Qty and $, Sales per total quotes sent, new quotes sent per day, week and month, Calls per week and month, etc



Lead & CRM Management:

Take full responsibility for maintaining the company's lead pipeline.

Manage and organise leads within Trello CRM, ensuring leads are correctly categorised and kept up to date.

Record client communications, quotation details, follow-ups, status changes, and outcomes.

Ensure all leads are actively progressed and that follow-ups are completed on time.

Monitor the sales pipeline and identify outstanding or inactive opportunities requiring attention.

Maintain accurate and up-to-date customer and sales information.



Marketing & Advertising:

Create, coordinate, publish, and manage marketing advertisements and campaigns.

Assist with developing promotional content and marketing initiatives.

Manage the day-to-day execution of online advertising activities.

Monitor campaign activity and identify opportunities for improvement.

Ensure advertisements and promotional material are accurate, current, and aligned with the company's brand and objectives.

Assist with maintaining the company's online presence and promotional activities



Purchasing & Supplier Coordination:

Place orders for selected products and materials through approved third-party suppliers.

Communicate with suppliers regarding pricing, availability, orders, and delivery requirements.

Monitor orders and follow up with suppliers as required.

Ensure products are ordered accurately and within required timeframes.

Maintain appropriate records of orders and supplier communications.



General Operations:

Manage a broad range of day-to-day operational tasks required to support the business.

Identify opportunities to improve internal processes, customer service, sales follow-up, and operational efficiency.

Provide general administrative and operational support as required.



Working Style & Accountability:

This position is suited to someone who enjoys working independently and taking ownership of their responsibilities.



The successful candidate will be expected to:



Work with a high level of independence and initiative.

Take ownership of the sales and operational tasks assigned to them.

Manage their own workload and priorities effectively.

Follow tasks through to completion without requiring constant supervision.

Keep management informed of important issues, opportunities, and results.

Escalate matters when management input or approval is required.

Maintain accurate records and ensure systems are consistently kept up to date.

Be proactive in identifying what needs to be done rather than waiting to be instructed.



Key Skills & Experience:

Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.

Excellent telephone and
 communication skills.

Strong sales follow-up and relationship-management skills.

Excellent organisational and time-management skills.

Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

Ability to manage multiple responsibilities and competing priorities.

Experience with CRM, lead-management, or task-management systems.

Experience with Trello or similar platforms is advantageous.

Experience creating or managing online advertisements and marketing campaigns is advantageous.

Strong computer and administrative skills.

Ability to work independently and take initiative.

A practical, solutions-focused approach to problem solving.





Key Performance Expectations

The successful candidate will be expected to ensure that:



All new leads receive an initial response within 24 hours.

Quotes are prepared and sent accurately and promptly.

Outstanding quotes and leads are consistently followed up.

The CRM and lead pipeline remain accurate and up to date.

Sales opportunities are actively managed through to a clear outcome.

Marketing campaigns and advertisements are regularly maintained and managed.

Orders are placed accurately and followed through.

Day-to-day operational tasks are completed efficiently and on time.

Management receives appropriate updates and escalation when required.

Customers receive professional, timely, and consistent communication.





HOW TO APPLY



We are very specific in who we are looking for and only those who answer the below questions in their cover letter will be shortlisted.

1. Must have own quiet home office with laptop, preferably 2 screens, a headset and fast and reliable internet with a backup option for incase internet is lost. Describe your home office setup, including internet speed (upload/download) and your backup plan during outages.

2. Must be tech savvy and be able to troubleshoot any technical problems on your own, you must be able to set up our operating systems once we share them with you. Please share with us your knowledge in being able to troubleshoot technical issues.

3. Must have experience in working remotely. Please tell us a bit about the remote work you have experience in.

4. Must have experience in administration, sales, customer service and estimating/quoting area. Tell us a bit about your experience with Gmail filters, inbox, lead and quotation management, marketing campaigns and working with KPI's experience. 

5. Do you have any planned leave or holidays in the next 12 months? If yes, please specify dates.

6. Propose the way of screens being recorded every day and a way to show proper evidence of you working 8 hours daily for us.

7. Include the word "ESTIMATOR" in the subject line or first sentence of your application to confirm you've read the full job ad.



Employment Details

• Rate: $7 AUD per hour

• Type: Full-time (remote)

• Duration: Long-term

• Start Date: ASAP

title: Luxury Real Estate Acquisitions & Dispositions Specialist
description:
Real Estate Acquisitions & Dispositions Specialist — Remote, Part-Time



We’re launching an independent real estate wholesaling business focused on properties and land suitable for luxury residential development.



We’re looking for someone with experience negotiating with sellers and helping deals reach closing. You will manage property research, developer relationships, seller outreach, follow-ups and transaction coordination, initially focusing on one target market.



Your role in the team



You may bring more hands-on real estate experience than the founder, and your knowledge will be valued. You are encouraged to suggest changes, share your opinions, identify problems and recommend better ways to work. If you disagree with an approach, explain your reasoning and propose an alternative.



The founder will continue running the business, managing its direction, budget and final decisions. You will be an important part of the team, with a meaningful voice in how we build and improve the operation.



Schedule



- Up to 20 paid hours per week, with flexible scheduling.

- Regular availability during business hours in our target U.S. market is required. We will agree on your availability before you start.

- This position may become full-time depending on business needs, performance and mutual interest. Full-time hours are not guaranteed.



Daily work times may vary around seller and developer appointments. When an appointment is scheduled in advance, arrange your research and administrative work around it.



If you accommodate an occasional call outside your planned work session, record all time spent and adjust your next session by agreement.



Example: You finish work at 3 PM but agree to take a developer’s call at 5 PM. If the call and related notes take 15 minutes, you can start your next session 15 minutes later or finish 15 minutes earlier, provided this does not conflict with scheduled appointments. The same applies to a five-minute call: record the time and adjust your next session by five minutes.



All work is paid and must be recorded on the day it occurs. You are not expected to remain on call all day. If you cannot accommodate an appointment outside your agreed availability, offer another time or notify the founder. Hours above the weekly limit require advance approval.



Compensation and growth



The starting base will be modest because this is a new business and we are building the operation before establishing consistent revenue. However, the starting rate does not have to remain your long-term rate.



We will review your performance after the first month. Strong performance may support a 200% raise after a first month. 



Closing bonuses



You will also receive a closing bonus based on the assignment fee actually collected by the company:



- Below $50,000: $100 closing bonus.

- $50,000 to under $100,000: $200 closing bonus.

- $100,000 to under $150,000: $400 closing bonus.

- $150,000 to under $200,000: $600 closing bonus.

- $200,000 to under $250,000: $800 closing bonus.

- $250,000 or more: $1,000 closing bonus.



Additional bonuses



- $500 first-closing bonus if your first qualifying deal closes and the company receives its assignment fee within your first 60 calendar days.

- $1,000 monthly bonus if you complete four or more qualifying closings in the same calendar month. This is a stretch incentive, not a monthly quota.



These bonuses can be combined. For example, a first qualifying closing within 60 days that generates a $100,000 assignment fee earns a $400 closing bonus plus the $500 first-closing bonus, in addition to base pay.



A qualifying deal is one you materially manage through your assigned responsibilities. Deal ownership and any shared bonus arrangements will be documented in advance. Bonuses are paid within 10 business days after the company receives cleared assignment-fee funds. A signed contract alone does not qualify as a completed closing.



Responsibilities



- Build developer relationships: Identify active builders and developers, contact them, and document their preferred locations, lot sizes, property types, budgets and timelines.

- Research properties: Review recent developer purchases, nearby luxury new builds, property records and comparable sales to identify suitable houses, teardown opportunities and vacant lots.

- Manage seller outreach: Find and verify contact information, conduct approved outreach, discuss seller needs and follow up consistently.

- Negotiate opportunities: Discuss price and terms within limits approved by the founder and prepare clear recommendations.

- Coordinate contracts: Use company-approved documents, arrange signatures after approval, and track deadlines and outstanding information.

- Manage the buyer side: Present opportunities to developers, follow up on interest and help coordinate assignment terms.

- Coordinate closing: Communicate with sellers, buyers, title companies, escrow teams and legal professionals, keeping the founder informed of progress and issues.

- Maintain accurate records: Keep property details, conversations, appointments and next steps organized.

- Improve the process: Recommend changes to research, outreach, follow-ups, tools and deal coordination based on your experience and results.



The founder approves all offers, prices, contracts and spending. You may not sign agreements or commit company funds without written authorization. Assigned duties will depend on applicable licensing requirements.



Software and support



The founder plans to develop internal software to organize properties, developer buying requirements, outreach, follow-ups, documents and deal deadlines. You will help identify features that would make the work easier.



Development will happen gradually, so you should be comfortable starting with spreadsheets and existing tools.



The company pays for approved business tools, property data and outreach expenses. You will not be expected to purchase leads or fund transactions personally.



Required experience



- U.S. real estate wholesaling, acquisitions or dispositions experience.

- Direct seller-negotiation experience and verifiable involvement in completed deals.

- Strong spoken and written English.

- Ability to research properties and understand comparable sales and assignment-fee calculations.

- Reliable follow-up, scheduling and recordkeeping.

- Confidence sharing recommendations and raising concerns respectfully.

- A computer, reliable internet and a quiet calling environment.



Experience with developers, land, teardown properties or luxury markets is preferred. Cold calling or appointment-setting experience alone is not sufficient.



First-month priorities



Learn the selected market, establish developer contacts, document buying requirements, research matching properties and build a consistent seller follow-up process. We will assess the quality of opportunities and progress through the pipeline, alongside activity.

title: Surplus Recovery Case Coordinator
description:
Surploom helps people pursue surplus funds after tax sales and mortgage foreclosures. We recently launched **SurploomOS**, software for surplus recovery work.



We’re looking for a reliable, organized person to coordinate individual cases as they are assigned. This is **case-by-case contract work**, not a part-time or full-time position. There are no guaranteed cases, hours, or monthly earnings. We currently have two potential claimant cases that may need coordination.



### What you’ll do



Depending on the case, you may:



- Review the available information, such as the sale type, county, property address, case number, sale date, claimant, and records.

- Research the applicable state, county, and court procedures.

- Contact the appropriate county office, court, trustee, or sale office to confirm whether funds are being held and ask about the claim process, required documents, and deadlines.

- Follow Surploom’s instructions and the rules that apply to that specific case. Requirements vary by location and sale type. If you can’t confirm a requirement, pause and ask Surploom before proceeding.

- Record the sources you checked, instructions received, deadlines, calls, and next steps.

- Speak with claimants respectfully, share case updates, and help them gather and organize documents requested by the relevant office.

- Coordinate administrative forms or submissions when appropriate.

- Follow up with the relevant office and document the case status and next steps.

- If a case may need legal help, coordinate a referral to an attorney in Surploom’s approved network.



These duties are examples; each case may require different steps. You must not provide legal advice, d
 who is legally entitled to funds, or perform legal work. A law degree or legal license is not required.



### What we’re looking for



- Availability for calls and follow-up during agreed U.S. business hours. Timing will depend on the case and the offices involved.

- Comfort speaking by phone with U.S. claimants and government or court offices.

- Clear, professional English over the phone. A perfect American accent is not required.

- Patience and respect when discussing sensitive circumstances, including financial hardship or a deceased family member.

- Strong organization, careful recordkeeping, dependability, and discretion with confidential information.

- Willingness to research unfamiliar procedures and ask for guidance when something is unclear.



Experience with case coordination, document preparation, customer support, or contacting government or court offices is helpful. Direct surplus recovery experience is welcome but not required.



### Compensation and workload



Pay is **$120 per assigned claimant case**, paid in three $40 installments for completed coordination work:



- **$40** after the initial review and documentation of the funds holder and claim process.

- **$40** after the claimant’s requested documents are organized and any appropriate administrative submission or handoff is completed.

- **$40** after the coordinator documents the office’s response, the current case status, and the next steps—or records that the case has reached an outcome.



Payment is for the coordination work and does not depend on whether the claimant receives funds. The coordinator does not need to wait for the claimant to receive funds to complete the final milestone. If a case requires substantially more work than expected, any additional compensation must be discussed and agreed upon before that extra work begins. Attorney fees and other case expenses are separate.



The time required will vary by case, and some cases may need follow-up over several weeks or months. We don’t yet have enough case history to promise a typical number of hours per case. There is no guaranteed weekly workload or ongoing assignment.



**Earnings examples at $120 per completed case:**



- 1 case: **$120**

- 2 cases: **$240**

- 4 cases: **$480**

- 8 cases: **$960**



These are examples only. Actual earnings depend on the cases Surploom assigns and the work completed.



### Possible future work



As Surploom grows, additional case coordination work may become available, including support for SurploomOS clients. Any new responsibilities and compensation would be discussed and agreed upon in advance. Future work, higher earnings, and a full-time role are not guaranteed.



### To apply



Please send a short introduction describing your experience with case coordination, document preparation, customer communication, or researching and contacting government or court offices. Include your availability during U.S. business hours and your experience handling phone calls.

title: Video Editor (Short-Form + High Volume | Sound Healing Brand, With 100 million views a month average)
description:
# Video Editor — Short-Form Talking Head / Meta & Instagram



Do you want to work on content that reaches millions of people while being part of a fast-growing transformation and sound healing brand built around community?



Our content averages roughly **50–150 million views per month**, and we’re looking for another strong editor to join our team full time.



We already have a full-time editor and are looking for someone who can become another key part of our content team.



## About the Role



The main focus of this role is editing **short-form talking-head videos for Instagram and Meta platforms**.



The style is intentionally simple and native-feeling:



- Talking head

- Clean cuts

- Captions

- Pop-ups and overlays

- Screenshots or supporting visuals

- Simple sound design

- Occasional music

- UGC-style pacing



It is not flashy editing.



The challenge is that the style is **very particular**.



We have tested thousands of pieces of content and have a specific format that performs well. We are looking for someone who can study reference videos and **match the editing style accurately instead of adding their own creative interpretation.**



You’ll be given examples, assets, sounds, overlays, and clear instructions.



Your job is to execute them cleanly, accurately, and quickly.



## What You’ll Be Editing



### Short-Form Talking Head Videos



This will be the majority of the role.



You’ll:



- Edit talking-head footage into clean, natural short-form videos

- Remove mistakes, repeated words, pauses, and unnecessary sections

- Maintain natural speech and pacing

- Add captions in the correct style

- Add simple pop-ups, screenshots, graphics, and overlays

- Place assets exactly where they need to appear

- Add background music and sound when required

- Match specific audio levels and timing

- Keep the video feeling native to Instagram and Meta

- Follow reference videos closely



The editing often looks simple to the viewer, but **timing, placement, audio, captions, and pacing matter a lot.**



We are looking for someone who notices those details.



### Micro Videos



You may also edit simple micro-content such as:



- Combine provided clip + sound

- Create clean, short vertical videos

- Make sure the ending feels intentional



### Long-Form Talking Head Videos



Occasionally you’ll also work on longer videos.



This includes:



- Removing pauses and mistakes

- Keeping dialogue flowing naturally

- Tightening pacing

- Finding strong moments

- Moving the strongest hook to the beginning when appropriate



### Other Occasional Tasks



- Basic video cleanup

- Course content

- Meditation videos

- Simple long-form content



## Editing Style



We will give you reference videos showing exactly what we want.



Your job is to:



- **Match the style**

- **Follow instructions exactly**

- **Keep edits clean**

- **Pay attention to tiny details**

- **Avoid unnecessary effects**

- **Understand what feels native on Instagram and Meta**



We care much more about **accuracy, pacing, retention, and clean execution** than complicated editing.



If the example uses a simple pop-up, we want the same kind of simple pop-up.



If the music stops at a specific moment, we want you to notice that.



If captions move slightly to make room for an overlay, we want you to understand why.



The editor we are looking for can watch a reference video and reproduce the style extremely closely.



## Important: Captions



For some of our main short-form formats, captions must be created using the **Edits app** so they look native to Instagram and Meta.



If you are not comfortable working with this workflow, this role may not be a fit.



## What We’re Looking For



- Strong experience editing talking-head short-form content

- Experience with Instagram Reels,
 Reels, TikTok, or UGC-style content

- Excellent understanding of English

- Strong sense of natural speech and dialogue pacing

- Ability to remove mistakes without making speech sound chopped up

- Ability to recognize cut-off words or awkward edits

- Very strong attention to detail

- Ability to match reference videos closely

- Comfortable following an established style instead of constantly reinventing it

- Reliable and consistent

- Good communication

- Fast turnaround

- Comfortable working at high volume

- Able to keep editing simple when simple is what works



## Speed Matters



This style can be somewhat involved when you first learn it.



However, many elements repeat from video to video.



Once you build templates and understand our system, the workflow should become significantly faster.



We are looking for someone who can produce this content **quickly and at high volume without losing accuracy.**



This is intended to be a **full-time editing position** for the right person.



## Pay



**$8/hour**



There is an opportunity for consistent ongoing work and growth with the company.



## Test Edit



Selected applicants will be asked to complete a test edit.



This is important because we are specifically looking to see whether you can **match our existing style accurately.**



We will provide:



- Raw footage

- Example video

- Instructional video

- Music

- Sounds

- Overlays

- Other necessary assets



If your test edit is strong, the next step will be an interview directly with me.



## To Apply



Please send:



- 3–5 examples of short-form talking-head videos you’ve edited

- Examples featuring pop-ups, captions, overlays, or UGC-style editing are strongly preferred

- 1–2 longer talking-head videos if available

- Your typical turnaround time

- Your current availability

- Your earliest start date



Please do **not** send only cinematic edits, music videos, gaming videos, or highly produced motion graphics.



We specifically want to see whether you understand **simple, high-retention talking-head content for Instagram and Meta.**

title: Pokémon / TCG Short-Form Video Editor (Reels, TikTok & Shorts)
description:
Pokémon / TCG Short-Form Video Editor — Long-Term Opportunity



We are a US-based Pokémon trading card business and content brand with over 600,000 followers across our social media platforms.



We're looking for a talented, creative, and detail-oriented video editor to help us produce engaging short-form content for Instagram Reels, TikTok,
, and YouTube Shorts.



Ideally, you're already a Pokémon fan who understands the TCG community and genuinely enjoys creating entertaining content.



What You'll Be Editing



Our content includes:

- Packing Pokémon card orders with entertaining storytelling

- Surprising customers with free products and giveaways

- Pokémon card conventions, shopping, and collecting adventures

- Funny, personality-driven videos and community interactions

- Product showcases and behind-the-scenes content



Most videos are approximately 45–90 seconds long.



What Makes a Great Candidate



1. Strong Short-Form Editing Experience



You understand hooks, storytelling, viewer retention, pacing, sound design, and comedic timing. You know how to make a video entertaining without overediting it.



2. Familiarity With Pokémon



Ideally, you play, collect, or follow the Pokémon TCG. You recognize popular Pokémon, understand booster boxes and card products, and are familiar with the collecting community.



Experience editing Pokémon content is a major advantage.



3. Exceptional Attention to Detail



You notice the little things: precisely timed sound effects, subtle zooms, caption placement, background music, transitions, and comedic moments.



We value intentional editing over unnecessary flashy effects.



4. Ability to Match an Established Style



We already have a recognizable content style. You'll be expected to study our existing videos, understand our personality and editing decisions, and produce content that feels consistent with our brand.



5. Creative Independence



We want someone who can contribute ideas, identify opportunities to improve a video, and make thoughtful editing decisions without needing instructions for every cut.



Requirements:

- Previous experience editing Instagram Reels, TikToks, or YouTube Shorts

- Strong portfolio of short-form content

- Good English comprehension, especially for humor and storytelling

- Reliable communication and turnaround times

- Ability to receive feedback and continuously improve

- Comfortable working with raw footage, voiceovers, and talking-head videos



Compensation & Schedule

- Remote, part-time position

- Starting budget: $500–$800 USD/month depending on experience and quality

- Approximately 20 hours per week

- Flexible working hours

- Long-term opportunity with potential for increased compensation



We'll begin with a paid editing trial before moving into an ongoing arrangement.



How to Apply

Please answer ALL of the following:

title: Bookkeeping Manager | Day shift
description:
You have run bookkeeping before. You know what a clean file looks like and you know exactly how it goes wrong. Now you want to build something bigger than your own desk.

Aureus Financial is hiring a Bookkeeping Manager to start, lead and grow our offshore bookkeeping division inside our Virtual CFO practice. This is not a role where you inherit a finished team. You start with a small team and you build it.



THE ROLE IN THREE SENTENCES

You will own the accuracy and timeliness of every client bookkeeping file that moves through our Virtual CFO service line. You will recruit, train and lead the bookkeepers who work under you. And you will design the systems and quality checks that let this division scale without things breaking.



WHY THIS MATTERS

Our accounting clients are Australian business owners who need more than a set of books. They need a bookkeeping function they can trust completely, so our advisers can focus on the advice that moves their business forward. Right now that function needs a leader. Get this right and you are the reason our clients get accurate numbers on time, every time.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN

Bookkeeping Delivery and Compliance

● Run reconciliations, accounts payable and receivable, payroll and BAS/IAS preparation across the client portfolio.

● Review every file before it reaches a client or the compliance team. If it is wrong, you catch it first.

Team Leadership and Development

● Recruit, onboard and manage the bookkeepers who join your division as it grows.

● Run coaching sessions that build real technical skill, not check-ins for the sake of it.

Process and Systems

● Build the SOPs, templates and quality-control checklists that make your division repeatable, not reliant on any one person.

● Push for the Xero, QBO and automation improvements that cut turnaround time without cutting accuracy.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS

● Every file in your portfolio is reconciled and closed within the agreed monthly turnaround.

● The first bookkeepers under you are onboarded, trained and producing work you would sign off yourself.

● You have a working set of SOPs and a clear view of where the bottlenecks are, with a plan to fix them.



WHO YOU ARE

● A senior bookkeeper who is done doing the work alone and ready to lead a team that does it at scale.

● Someone who treats a client file the way a pilot treats a checklist. Nothing gets signed off on a hunch.

● Direct and organised. You would rather flag a problem early than let it surprise someone later.

● Comfortable working directly with senior leadership, with no layers between your work and the decisions it feeds.



WHAT YOU NEED TO BRING

● 5 or more years of Australian bookkeeping experience.

● Hands-on BAS, IAS, STP payroll and superannuation, not just AP/AR and reconciliations.

● Experience leading or supervising a remote bookkeeping team. Tell us the team size and how long you led it.

● Confident hands-on skill in Xero and/or QuickBooks Online. Xero Advisor certification is a plus.

● A track record of being the last line of defence on file quality, not just a contributor to it.

● Comfortable working Sydney-aligned hours, with at least 5 hours of daily overlap.



WHAT WE OFFER

● Base salary of up to Php80k per month or higher for the right candidate.

● A fully remote independent contractor role. You manage your own tax and statutory obligations.



Submit your application here:

title: TikTok Account Executive
description:
The Role

We are seeking a strategic, client-focused TikTok Account Executive to manage a portfolio of TikTok Shop brands and drive measurable business growth. This role serves as the primary point of contact for clients while collaborating closely with our Philippines-based Creator Management, Operations, Creative, and Support teams to deliver exceptional results.



Position Summary

The TikTok Account Executive is responsible for the overall success and growth of an assigned portfolio of TikTok Shop clients. This role owns client relationships, develops account growth strategies, monitors business performance, and coordinates cross-functional teams to execute affiliate, creator, and campaign initiatives that drive GMV growth.



The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker with strong communication skills, a passion for e-commerce, and the ability to manage multiple client relationships while delivering measurable business results.



Key Responsibilities

Client Relationship Management

* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned TikTok Shop clients.

* Build trusted relationships through proactive communication and strategic guidance.

* Lead weekly business reviews and monthly performance meetings.

* Understand each client’s business objectives and develop customized growth strategies.

* Manage client expectations while ensuring timely follow-up and issue resolution.



Growth Strategy & Account Management

* Own the GMV performance of assigned client portfolios.

* Develop strategies to increase sales through affiliate marketing, creator activations, livestreams, promotions, and product launches.

* Identify growth opportunities and recommend optimization strategies.

* Monitor account health and proactively adjust strategies to maximize performance.

* Forecast monthly GMV performance and communicate progress against goals.



Campaign & Cross-Functional Execution

* Partner with Creator Managers, Operations, Creative, and Support teams to execute client initiatives.

* Coordinate affiliate campaigns, promotional events, creator activations, and product launches.

* Ensure projects are delivered accurately and on schedule.

* Escalate and resolve operational issues while maintaining a high level of client satisfaction.



Performance Reporting & Optimization

* Analyze account performance using TikTok Shop analytics and other reporting tools.

* Prepare weekly and monthly client reports highlighting GMV, traffic, conversion, affiliate performance, and key growth metrics.

* Present actionable recommendations based on performance data.

* Stay current on TikTok Shop updates, platform trends, and best practices to continuously improve client results.



Qualifications

Required

* 3+ years of experience in Account Management, Customer Success, E-commerce, Digital Marketing, or Client Services.

* Experience managing multiple client accounts simultaneously.

* Strong understanding of TikTok Shop, influencer marketing, affiliate marketing, or social commerce.

* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

* Strong analytical, organizational, and project management skills.

* Ability to interpret performance data and translate insights into actionable strategies.

* Self-motivated with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, remote environment.



Preferred

* Direct TikTok Shop experience.

* Shopify, Amazon, Walmart Marketplace, or e-commerce experience.

* Affiliate marketing or creator partnership experience.

* Experience with ClickUp, 
, Asana, or similar project management platforms.

* Experience using ChatGPT and AI productivity tools.

* Experience working with remote or global teams.



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Achieve 100% or greater of assigned monthly and quarterly GMV targets across the client portfolio.

* Deliver consistent month-over-month GMV growth for assigned accounts.

* Maintain a client retention rate of 95% or higher.

* Ensure 100% on-time delivery of client reports, campaign launches, and business reviews.

* Increase affiliate and creator participation while improving overall account performance.

* Maintain excellent client satisfaction through proactive communication and strategic partnership.

* Deliver accurate forecasting and identify new revenue opportunities for assigned brands.



Success Looks Like

Within your first 90 days, you will:

* Successfully onboard and manage an assigned portfolio of TikTok Shop clients.

* Build strong relationships with clients and internal cross-functional teams.

* Consistently deliver strategic recommendations supported by performance data.

* Achieve or exceed assigned portfolio GMV goals.

* Demonstrate ownership, accountability, and proactive communication.

* Become a trusted strategic advisor who contributes directly to client growth and long-term business success.



Work Location / Setup

* Remote

title: Virtual Assistant - Phone Sales (US e-commerce, beauty, wellness & telehealth brands)
description:
Company: Cynex Philippines

Location: Remote, Philippines (work from home)

Type: Full time

Pay: $700/month fixed, plus $1 for every live transfer. On-target earnings about $2,000/month.



About the role

Cynex Philippines works with well-known US brands in e-commerce, skincare and beauty, health and wellbeing, and telehealth. Every day, shoppers in the United States start an order online, add the product to the cart, and then stop before they pay. As a Virtual Assistant on our phone team, you call those shoppers, answer their questions, and transfer the warm call live to a closer.



You are not making cold calls. The shopper already chose the product. Your job is to open the conversation, remove the doubt, and hand over a warm call.



What you will do

- Call US shoppers who started an online order with one of our brand partners

- Listen, answer basic questions about the product and the offer, and keep the shopper on the line

- Live-transfer the warm call to a senior sales rep

- Record each call outcome in our system

- Follow our call scripts and our rules on honesty and respect for the customer



What we offer

- $700 per month fixed pay, paid on time every month

- $1 for every live transfer you make, on top of the fixed pay

- On-target earnings of about $2,000 per month (fixed pay plus transfers)

- Full-time, remote, work from home anywhere in the Philippines

- US hours (night shift in the Philippines), schedule agreed with your team leader

- Paid training before your first call, and coaching every week

- A live dashboard where every transfer you make shows the same day

- No fees, no leads to buy, and nothing to pay to start



What we look for

- Based in the Philippines

- Clear, confident spoken English with a neutral accent

- You are comfortable on the phone and you enjoy talking with people

- Reliable high-speed internet (at least 20 Mbps), a backup connection, and a quiet place to work

- A computer with at least 8 GB RAM and a USB noise-cancelling headset

- Able to work US hours, Monday to Friday

- Previous phone sales, appointment setting or customer service experience is a plus. We train you.



How to apply

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph. Include your city, your internet speed, your computer specs, a few lines about your experience on the phone, and a short voice recording (30 to 60 seconds) introducing yourself in English. A short phone interview is the next step.



Cynex Philippines is an equal opportunity employer.
